com.epicgames.FortniteGame.n:
THE HUNT CONTINUES
Buggy and his crew crash onto the island looking for trouble, and more crews are on the way. Face new bosses, wield new weapons, and collect all-new Sprites as the hunt heats up. Who knows what you’ll find in the next Chest...

ROCK OUT IN PORTRAIT
No need to flip your phone. Fortnite Festival now plays in portrait from start to finish, making it easier than ever to play on the go.

TREASURE HUNTERS: The Greatest Adventure of All Time
Drop into a mysterious new skull-shaped island and join the hunt for legendary treasure. Collect new Sprites, take down powerful bosses, and unleash anime-inspired weapons. The hunt is on.
Emergent bug and stability fixes

The Curse Continues
The nightmare isn't over. More haunting Overrides and horror icons are joining the Island. Drop in, face your fears, and survive the rest of Fortnitemares 2026.
Emergent bug and stability fixes

Fortnitemares 2026 is Here
A cursed cartridge is corrupting Battle Royale with new Overrides, weapons, and horror icons on the Island. Also, squad up in Horde Rush against waves of monsters before the corruption spreads to Reload, where the Nitemare Island map returns on October 8.

The Worlds of KINGDOM HEARTS Come to Fortnite
Call down new KINGDOM HEARTS Overrides, wield the new Kingdom Key melee weapon, and fight the darkness with new Sora, Riku, Kairi, and Roxas Outfits!
Emergent bug and stability fixes

OG Season X is Here
Fortnite OG enters Season X with classic POIs, returning loot, and an all-new OG Pass.

Take Control in Battle Royale
New Loot Hacks, Sprites, and match-wide Overrides arrive on the Island.
General Bug & Stability Fixes

Break the rules and change the game in Fortnite Battle Royale Chapter 7 Season 4: Override. Team up with gaming legends, best baddies with new weapons and loot, and catch new Sprites at new locations around the Island.
General bug and stability fixes.

Queens rapper Lil Tecca headlines Fortnite Festival Season 15 with new Jam Tracks and instruments to unlock in the Neon Dreams Music Pass.

Reload comes to Springfield with an all-new POI, a Simpsonified John Wick Outfit Battle Pass reward, and a new Ranked Season.
It's Hot Bat Summer in Battle Royale! Get the new Batman Sprite, glide across the Island with a new Batman vehicle, and check out new DC villains in the shop!

New Sprites in BR

Karaoke Comes to Mobile: Now featuring Olivia Rodrigo and her new single "drop dead" in Fortnite Festival.

Something New Each Week: New Sprite Days, Golden Hours, Mastery Mondays, and more!
General Bug & Stability Fixes
A new season begins in Battle Royale! Drop into Chapter 7 Season 3: Runners today. Collect Sprites, explore a new map, get a Victory Royale with updated weapons and equipment.
Jump into Shattered, the End of Season Live Event, at 7pm ET on June 5th.
General Bug & Stability Fixes
New gear. New maps. New allies. Overwatch in Fortnite!

Reload gets the new Cube Splitter SMG that attaches exploding cubes to enemies, and Battle Royale gets map updates and weapon unlocks as Act II of the season-long Showdown rages on.

LEGO Fortnite Odyssey continues the Ninjago saga. Take down the Shatter Spawn in the Shatter Dragon Arena, fight new Oni enemies and recruit Kai as a villager.

And keep an eye to the skies, new Star Wars games are launching on May 1!

Showdown Act 2 - The Elites
The showdown continues in Battle Royale Act 2 with new loot like the Cube Rifle.

New Reload Map - Elite Stronghold
Explore four new POIs, new weapons, and unlock new ranked rewards.

Festival Season 14 ft. Laufey
GRAMMY-winning artist Laufey takes the stage!

OG Season 8
As the Showdown rages on in Battle Royale Chapter 7 Season 2, X marks the spot in OG Season 8. Find buried treasure in tropical places waiting to be rediscovered.

LEGO Fortnite Odyssey - NINJAGO®: Mist of the Deep
Things are heating up for NINJAGO in April. To start, there's a strange mist off NINJAGO Island's coast and it's up to you to investigate.

New Mode Coming April 9: Fortnite Arenas
1v1 against friends or square up as a team in this mode all 'bout boxfights.
This Battle Royale Season, choose your side, take down your Rivals, and settle the score in Fortnite: Showdown.

ios.gridplus.busjam.carpuzzle.n:
【More ways to play and compete!】

Discover new Player Profiles, climb the Leaderboard, and follow your progress with the new Task Bar and improved navigation.

Take on 20 new levels, from Level 201 to 220, filled with fresh challenges!

Enjoy faster garage departures, quicker level loading, and smoother performance across devices.

We’ve also fixed an issue that could cause add-on bundles to display incorrectly and made additional stability improvements.

Update now and keep the buses rolling!

【New levels, new twists!】

Explore fresh puzzles with new mechanics that will put your strategy skills to the test.

Plan your moves, clear the traffic, and keep the buses rolling!

Update now and take on your next challenge!

【Display Issue Fixed】

This update fixes an issue where the contents shown in the bundle UI did not match the items actually granted.
This was a display error only. The actual bundle contents were granted correctly and were not affected.
Please update to the latest version to see the corrected bundle information. We apologize for any confusion this may have caused.

【Important Bug Fix!】

This update fixes an issue where ads could still appear after purchasing the Remove Ads / Ad-Free Bundle.
If you experienced this issue, please update to the latest version, open the Settings pop-up on the Home screen, and tap the Restore button to restore your purchase.
We apologize for the inconvenience and thank you for your patience and support.
Featuring newly upgraded levels and content. We hope you enjoy your time in Bus Fever!

In V1.3.0:
Conquest: Eye of the Storm
8-server battle! Boost Pulse Resist, upgrade buildings & seize the Stormbreaker! 3 Signature Armaments, themed event, new Insignia rewards, and Conquest Trucks/Omen Express.
New Features
Titles, Drone Model ratings, Legend Rankings cosmetics & tally change (Monday 00:00).
Optimizations
Optimized Honor Exhibit, Marksman Challenge, Drill Grounds, Alliance Exercise, Drone upgrades, alert visuals, Alliance Gifts, and bonus description (effects unchanged).

New Features

Motor Pool Quick Raids
If you are on a server that has been open for at least 60 days, you can now access the new Quick Raid function in the Motor Pool. Simply tap on another Commander's truck and hit the Quick Raid button to instantly launch an attack.

Claim All for Shop Rewards
If you have an active Monthly Pass, Monthly Pass+, or any Weekly Pass, you can now use a new shortcut button on the main screen sidebar to claim all of your daily pass rewards with a single tap.

New Cosmetics: Identity Tags
With this update, a new Identity Tags tab has been added to the cosmetics section. When equipped, an Identity Tag applies a custom, decorative frame to your Commander nameplate, visible directly under your base on the world map.

Live Voice Chat & Group Admins
1. Live Voice Chat: We are introducing a live voice chat feature! You can start a live voice chat in the Alliance channel or any private group chat to communicate with other Commanders in real time.
2. Group Admins: Custom group chats now feature an admin system. The group owner can appoint members as admins, granting them the permission to edit the group name and remove members.
(Please Note: To experience these new chat features, you must update the game to the latest version via your device's app store).

Feature Optimizations

1. Rookie Drill Grounds Battle Reports: Following this update, battle reports in the Rookie Drill Grounds will display much more detailed data, making it easier to review and analyze your combat performance.

2. Alliance Tech Donation UI: When donating to Alliance tech, you can tap the resources displayed at the top of the screen to open the resource replenishment panel. This allows you to quickly restock any resources you need.

3. Combat Readiness Update: We have added a new Overall Rating tab to the Combat Readiness feature. Plus, we have upgraded the rewards for reaching total Power milestones to include new avatar Frames, collectibles, Commander portraits, and more!

4. Campaign Stage Optimization: We have adjusted the unlock requirements for the Quick Battle and Auto-Battle features. After the update, both functions will unlock automatically after clearing Stage 104, making your campaign progression much smoother and more convenient.

5. New Game Icon: We updated the app icon to match the game's recent visual upgrades.

Bug Fixes
1. Fixed an issue in Combat Readiness where Power and Total Commander Power were displaying incorrectly.
2. Fixed an issue where Stamina was not being deducted correctly when launching consecutive attacks against other Commanders. After the update, Stamina will correctly deduct after every attack.

New Features
We are introducing 2 new features to the Alliance Overview menu: the Unity Cache and the Admin Guide. These additions are designed to make daily Alliance activities more rewarding for all members, while providing exclusive daily bonuses for Alliance leadership.
1. Unity Cache
- Alliances now have a daily active member objective.
- Once an Alliance hits this daily objective, eligible members can claim a random supply cache—and those who receive a high-value reward can post it in the Alliance chat channel to share the joy!
2. Admin Guide
When the Alliance meets its active member goal, eligible Lvl 4 and Lvl 5 members can also claim an exclusive login reward through the new Admin Guide feature.

Feature Optimizations
1. We have lowered the member requirement to participate in Tactical Rivalry. Alliances now only need 10 members to join, making the event accessible to a wider range of Alliances.

Bug Fixes
1. Fixed a UI issue in the chat channel where server broadcast messages were blocking the Goodie Packet bubble labels.

com.activision.callofduty.shooter.n: New themed season, with 50 tiers of rewards in the Battle Pass. All new content: new maps, characters, themed events and modes. Bugs fixes and technical improvements.
New themed season, with 50 tiers of rewards in the Battle Pass. All new content: new maps, characters, themed events and modes. Bugs fixes and technical improvements.

The Phantom Thieves have infiltrated Call of Duty®: Mobile Season 6: Take Your Heart. Answer the Calling Card and deploy as Persona 5 Royal-inspired Operators, including Joker, Panther, and more. Secure the treasure in an all-new Battle Royale LTM, then wield the Mythic FFS Hurricane to complete the perfect heist. Take your time, then Take Over.

Persona 5 Royal x CODM

Another season of collaboration is here! Experience a first-of-its-kind integration featuring Legendary Operators inspired by the Phantom Thieves. These Operators can summon their Personas during entry animations and a special emote, and also feature unique team-up and operator swap animations inspired by the world of Persona 5 Royal.

The collaboration also includes a themed weapon for one of the featured Operators, available in the Series Armory. Collect all Persona 5 Royal content to unlock a special dance emote featuring iconic music from the game, along with a weapon swap effect and additional rewards.

Looking for free rewards? Progress through the themed engagement event to earn even more Persona 5 Royal content.

Plunder Treasure Hunt LTM

Take on a new twist on Battle Royale’s Plunder mode. Drop in and stay alert for announcements revealing the location of a treasure cache. Once it appears, race to the marked area and cross the treasure barriers, where intense battles await against shadows, treasure demons, and rival squads. Eliminate all opposition to claim treasure chests packed with cash, Personas Masks, and other valuable rewards. Build your fortune throughout the match and secure victory by ending the game with the most cash in the lobby.

Mythic FSS Hurricane

The Mythic FSS Hurricane is dropping in Season 6! Unlock the FSS Hurricane - Shadow Skyline in the Shadow and Shade Draw and overwhelm opponents with spectral, afterlife-inspired animations and effects. Witness souls drawn from fallen enemies and absorbed into the weapon as it transforms before your eyes, unleashing haunting visual effects inspired by wandering spirits. Pair it with Samael – Hollow Regent and complete the set to bring a mysterious, supernatural presence to every match.

New Battle Passes

Steal the show in Season 6 with a Battle Pass packed with rewards, including the debut of the FSS Hurricane, a new high-capacity SMG built for sustained firepower. Upgrade to the Premium Pass to unlock even more content, featuring rewards like High Priest of Chaos – Judgement, along with weapon blueprints, operator skins, charms, emotes, and other cosmetics earned throughout the season.

Season 6 also welcomes the return of several nostalgic Battle Pass Vaults, including Synthwave Showdown, Wild Dogs, and Elite of Elite. Revisit these classic seasons and unlock rewards you may have missed the first time around—but don’t wait too long, these Vaults won’t stay open forever. Looking ahead, even more Vault content is set to arrive in Season 7.

The target is locked in and the clock is ticking. Gear up, strike fas

Lock in or get locked up—Call of Duty®: Mobile Season 4: Eternal Prison is here. Jump in to Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire content, deploy into the first season of DMZ: Recon, and experience Rebirth Island in both DMZ: Recon and Battle Royale.

Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire
Call of Duty®: Mobile’s newest collaboration is here! Experience the Monsterverse with operator skins inspired by Godzilla and Kong, featuring Cassius - ARMOR: Godzilla and Cosmic Silverback - B.E.A.S.T. Bring their presence into every match as you dominate the opposition.

Each draw includes a pool of themed items and a signature Legendary Weapon, complete with exclusive animations, kill effects, and more. Don’t miss this season’s engagement event, offering additional ways to earn Monsterverse rewards and expand your collection.

DMZ: Recon
The debut season of DMZ: Recon introduces all-new experiences on Rebirth Island. Face off against the first defensive boss, Nikto, who uses shielding abilities to counter incoming attacks. Utilize the new crafting system to build specialized weapons and gain an edge in combat. com.triumphsdkprod.n: Hello all, here is a new version for you. You probably are busy with something else this weekend, but for PC gamers here's this update.
We fixed that thing on that one screen. We are hoping to get to that other thing another time.

'twas the night before Tuesday, and all through the app no bug report was sent, not a crash, and no lag. The dashboards went quiet, the logs said all clear - when a lone bug report, late at night, did appear;
I don't think writer block is a thing. Pretty easy to write these release notes.
Ah yes, forgot that one thing. Good thing I remembered.
I think my vision is healing, everything just been less blurry lately.
Called it that I wouldn't be able to handle two screens. Made the app better now.
They didn’t believe in us, but you know who did? Claude did.
My life is a never-ending struggle to fix something, then to fix what I just "fixed" last release. I can't say I don't like it though - this is truly my dream.

Here's a summary of this week:

- Main view? Clean.
- Launch times? Fixed (I hope).
- Smaller sized devices? A bit better.
- My love life? She's never coming man..
I'm so eager to get ahead of this week - You know what? I'm gonna give you one more update, just for fun. #YOLO

Hey, this is the new guy.
Other guy took off today for a festival.

I messed some stuff up, fixed it in this build.
Hope you enjoy the new stuff!

Yeah we added stuff in this version and stuff... Anyways, Karen please call me back I just wanna see my kids.

But yeah this new stuff we added in this version is pretty cool too I guess.
Roses are red, And violets blue like the sea. At least I've been working only on things you won't see.
I heard the weather has been real nice lately. I guess I was too busy working on these new features to notice.
For great events like this one happening today - I think to myself, wow I really don't have any friends.. well, I'll just type in random numbers until I can guess the code for your lobby.

Wooo!! Friday build cut! You know what that means - either we have tons of features and a new game in this release, or Jim wasn't here to enforce me cutting it on Wednesday.

Your guess is as good as mine on this one. #SorryJim #SorryNotSorry #FridayBuildCut
we slightly updated the app icon in this release, it's one of my greatest achievements.
Another weekly update down - 5,888,524,741 more left to go.
We are feeling super generous today, so here's another version update! My fans of my release notes have told me I should get my writing out more, so this is my attempt at that.

We were gonna release last Wednesday but seemed best to get more stuff in and wait for Thursday - Then Friday came along but we don't release on Fridays, so Monday came up and we figured might as well get one more thing in for Tuesday. And by the time Tuesday came around we thought - might as well wait for Wednesday.

So here we are on Wednesday. We really do stick to our word around here (we got 2 more extra things in)

Hey it's me the friendly release note writer, I swear there's so many things in this update. You can take my word on it, you can always trust me - I'm the friendly release note writer.

Please update so I can keep my job.

I can't think of anything for this versions release notes. But the amount of dedication I have just for these release notes alone means I'm just gonna write I can't think of anything here.

The app seems faster, hopefully less bugs - the usual.
I was told a weekly release schedule helps create a "stable work environment" because it's a "predictable cadence" - I hope this makes you feel stable Jim

When life gives us lemons, we will spend more than a week on a single release. Also those lemons started to grow mold.

I give my condolences to the bugs we lost along the way.
We worked really hard for this patch release. Things are fixed now.

com.gof.global.n:
[New Content]
1. New Event: Mergeventure — A world of discovery awaits! Spend Merge Energy to activate generators and create Pieces during the event. Merge identical Pieces into higher-level Pieces, then collect the required Pieces to clear the fog and uncover new areas and surprise rewards. Use certain max-level Pieces to obtain Merge Coins or other items. Exchange your Merge Coins for rewards at the "Mergeventure Caravan". Complete Daily Missions and fill your Mergeventure Atlas as you explore, one merge at a time!
2. New "Gift" feature: Reach Furnace Lv. 13 to send Gifts to other Chiefs. Add a personal message to make each Gift extra special! Gifts let you connect with others and express yourself. They offer no combat stats/bonuses and cannot be regifted. Earn Gifts through daily activity, missions, and events, or meet specific requirements to purchase rare Gifts. Send Gifts to earn Gift Points, raise your Gift Level, and unlock exclusive rewards. Collect the Gifts you receive and display them on your Chief Profile and in your Gift Showcase.
3. New "Popularity" feature: Give other Chiefs Likes on their profiles, in select events, and on leaderboards. Likes you receive add to your Popularity, which is displayed on your Chief Profile. Chief Profiles are also getting a fresh look to help showcase your activity and standout moments to other Chiefs.
4. New Expedition Arena: Unlocks as your State nears the release of Furnace Fire Crystal Lv. 3. Expedition Arena and Exploration Arena will alternate each week. Set up your defensive formation, then challenge those of other Chiefs. Battles in this mode are based on Chiefs' Expedition stats and incur no actual losses. Win challenges to earn Arena Points, climb the daily and seasonal rankings, and earn rewards.
5. New Expert: Royal Counselor Justus will soon join your City. As a former minister of the Solaris Dynasty, he is known for his fairness and wisdom. He once assisted Her Highness the Princess in establishing a safe haven and protecting survivors. Now, this advisor, well-versed in statecraft and governance, will provide valuable support for your City's development!
6. New Calendar Reminder feature: Eligible Chiefs can tap "Add Calendar Reminder" on the event screen to add the event’s name, start time, and end time to their device’s calendar. Available for Foundry Battle, Tundra Arms League, Canyon Clash, Bear Hunt, and Crazy Joe. Your device will notify you before the event starts according to your calendar reminder settings.
7. New "Chief Appearance" feature: Brand-new Prestige Appearances are coming soon! Chiefs with Prestige Benefits can open "Prestige Benefits", select the "Prestige Appearance" tab, and purchase "Emblem of Exquisiteness Packs" to obtain "Emblems of Exquisiteness". Spend the required number of "Emblems of Exquisiteness" to unlock the Prestige Appearance Theme of your choice.

[Optimizations & Adjustments]

(1) Agnes' "Efficient Recon" skill has been upgra

[New Content]
1. New "Fire Crystal Age" Expansion:
Winter will one day be lit by fire! Once the Furnace reaches Fire Crystal Lv. 1, your City will officially enter the "Fire Crystal Age".
In this new age, survivors are gradually overcoming the threats of bitter cold and death. Complete Survivor Profiles give every survivor in the City a unique identity.
As life becomes more stable, survivors begin to hope for better housing, food, healthcare, work, and entertainment. The old Mailbox will be transformed into the "Wish Station", where survivors can share their hopes for a better future.
As the Furnace Level increases and prerequisite Wishes are completed, more Wishes will become available. Completing Wishes rewards Chiefs with "Wish Sigils", which can be exchanged in the "Wish Shop" for exclusive materials used to construct future entertainment Buildings.
At the same time, the Chief Order feature will enter a new phase alongside city development. Some old Chief Orders will be removed after entering the Fire Crystal Age, and new Chief Orders such as "Crunch Time", "Advanced Training", and "Dawn Alliance Commendation" will be added to provide new support for resource production, soldier training, and city development.
2. New "Endless Trials" Gameplay: Wulfgar, the barbarian chieftain known as the "Windhowler" from the far north, is about to appear on the tundra! After the event begins, eligible Chiefs can head to the Wilderness after 00:30 (UTC) each day to challenge the "Windhowler". Each Chief can launch up to 30 solo attacks per day; rallies cannot be initiated. The system will calculate daily rankings based on each Chief's highest single-instance damage that day. The event includes daily participation rewards, daily leaderboard rewards, and achievement rewards to help Chiefs keep pushing the limits of the trial.
3. New Value Events:
(1) Introducing "Hero Ascension Training". Chiefs can earn event points by ascending the corresponding heroes during the event. Reach the specified point targets to collect rewards for each tier. Unlock "Battle Stars" to earn even greater rewards.
(2) Introducing "Exclusive Gear Forge". Chiefs can earn event points by developing the Exclusive Gear of the corresponding heroes during the event. Reach the specified point targets to collect rewards for each tier. Unlock "Champion Forge" to earn even greater rewards.

[Optimizations & Adjustments]
1. Overview Feature Optimization: A new "Daily" tab will be added to the in-game Overview panel on the left. Chiefs can use this tab to view the progress, remaining attempts, and claimable status of daily content such as the Arena, Treks, The Labyrinth, Crystal Laboratory, Hero Recruit, Alliance Contribution, Lighthouse, Online Rewards, Expert Skills, Alliance Activity Triumph, and more, making it easier to plan daily tasks efficiently.
2. Chief Gear and Charm Level Cap Increase: In States where the state progress has already unlocked Gen 6 heroes, Legendary T6 Chief Gear (3-Star

[New Content]
1. New Event: The all-new Winter Siege is coming soon! Fight alongside your allies in alliance stronghold battles. Deploy garrison squad and attack enemy strongholds to earn victory and valuable rewards for your alliance. Gather your allies and prepare for a brand-new strategic challenge!
2. New Expert: Gareth, the Ironthorn Chief, is about to join your adventure. A young commander from the Janvide Mountains, Gareth has earned the legendary title of "Ironthorn" by repeatedly repelling Mordheim's invasions with his exceptional leadership and flexible tactics!
Reminder:
Gareth will become available in eligible States on UTC 07/20/2026 at 00:00.

[Optimizations & Adjustments]
1. Chief Avatar Improvements: A new "Preview Avatar Frame" option will be added to the confirmation popup when uploading a custom avatar. You can choose whether to display your current avatar frame, making it easier to preview the overall appearance of your custom avatar and frame combination.
2. Expert Improvements:
(1) Added an Idle Trek Status popup, allowing Chiefs to view current Idle Trek progress and completion status before entering exploration stages.
(2) Agnes's skill "Project Management" now grants a "Increases Research Speed" bonus, helping you advance research more efficiently.
3. Fishing Tournament Improvements:
(1) Improved the overall fishing experience. Added current season deepest depth records and extreme depth indicators to help Chiefs better judge depths.
(2) A beginner tutorial will now be available when participating in the Fishing Tournament for the first time, helping Chiefs learn fishing controls more quickly.
(3) Added filter options to the Guide page. Chiefs can now filter entries by season or acquisition status.
(4) After unlocking the Seaweed Guide, a new 10x Fishing option will become available. Fishing gear will also automatically start at max level, helping Chiefs participate in Fishing Tournaments more efficiently.
4. Daybreak Island Improvements:
(1) Added a new basic decoration: "Frostgrove", bringing more beauty and depth to your Daybreak Island.
(2) Added the "Mark of Revival Shop". Once the Tree of Life level and State Progress meet the required conditions, Chiefs can purchase "Marks of Revival" from Daybreak Island Supplies and exchange them for decorations and accessories. Shop contents will unlock in phases as State Progress advances.
5. Game Settings Improvements: A new "Swipe Back" toggle will be added to iOS settings after the update. When enabled, swipe inward from either side of the screen to quickly return to the previous page. This gesture will be disabled in certain interfaces to prevent accidental activation.
6. Scouting Improvements: When viewing a Chief outside your alliance, if you or an ally has recently scouted the target, a preview of the latest scouting report will be displayed. You can also quickly open the report to review troops and lootable resource info.
7. Battle Mail Improvements: Hero portraits in t

[New Content]
1. New Feature: Flame Tech. Once your State reaches the required number of days and unlocks Helios Troops, the advancements in the Fire Crystal technology will strengthen our troops even more.
2. New Event: The all-new [Icefire Warhymn League] is about to begin! Answer the call of the Icebreaker Alliance, and join the intense solo competition! The event consists of four phases: Sign-Up, Qualifier, Elimination, and Pinnacle. No troops will be lost during the event. Compete for generous rewards! Top Chiefs can earn permanent Daybreak Island decorations, and the champion will be crowned with the ultimate glory. Match predictions will also be available—use your strategy to win extra rewards! Sign up now and prove your tactics and strength!
3. New Feature: Collection Gallery. View all permanent skins you own, and show off your Collection to other Chiefs! Earn Collection Points by collecting permanent skins. Earn more Collection Points and increase your Collection Level to unlock rewards!
4. New Expert: Mine Leader Kathy is joining your adventure! Her courage and leadership will help you conquer the challenges of Frostfire Mine.

[Optimizations & Adjustments]
1. Dreamscape Memory
(1) Once your State has opened for the required number of days, Dreamscape Memory will become a recurring event. Time to show your skills and teamwork!
(2) Adjusted the content of Dream Traveler Pack and Dream Sojourner.
2. Tundra Trading Station: Quick-Exchange all excess Max Star Hero Shards and Max Level Exclusive Gear Widgets once your State has opened for the required number of days.
3. Frostfire Mine: Reduced max Chiefs per match to improve matchmaking and performance.
4. Expulsion: R4 members can now expel other R4 members' garrisoned troops.
5. Emotes: Added [Response Emote] settings. You can assign Action Emotes you own to scenarios: Victory, Defeat, Thanks, Greetings. When a certain scenario is triggered, the system will automatically send the preset Action Emote in response.
6. Chief Profile: You can now tap on another Chief's avatar across Reinforcements at Embassy, Appointment, and Alliance War pages to view profiles directly.
7. Furnace Upgrade Rewards: Reach Furnace Lv. 7 to receive 10 [Deployment Recall] items, which will be sent to your Backpack.
8. Fortress Battle:
(1) Added [Cancel Sign-up] button for Fortress. R4+ members can cancel the Sign-up manually in the [Signed Up] interface.
(2) Added "Reward" Icon Button on the Fortress interface located in Alliance - Battle - Fortress to quickly view reward details in the "Fortress Battles" interface.
9. Mercenary Prestige: Total stages reduced from 50 to 25 for all difficulty levels in the next season.
10. Deployment Interface:
(1) Deployment interface now shows arrival time preview for Rallies.
(2) If a hero in the formation is not in City, a yellow bubble will be displayed.
(3) If there are insufficient troops in City, a red bubble will be displayed.
11. Spectator Mode: Real-time spectator count a

[New Content]
1. New Expert: The legendary mercenary Ronne is joining your adventure! Her strength and cunning will help you overcome the challenges of the Tundra Trade Route.

[Improvements & Adjustments]
1. Wild Brawl
- Once your State has opened for the required number of days, Wild Brawl will become a recurring event. Now you can jump into solo battles whenever it's available!
- Each event session now gives you 6 attempts. The daily mission requirement has been lowered to align with this change, but the total event rewards remain the same.
- Hero exclusive gear skills that boost City defense will no longer affect battlefield structure defense.
2. Troop Training: Added separate tabs for each camp on the troop training screen. Just tap the tab to jump straight to the type of troops you want to train. Much faster and easier!
3. Top-up Gift: Added new reward tiers. Unlock them to earn the exclusive [Crystal Starlight Avatar Frame] and [Crystal Starlight Nameplate]. If you've already finished the event, you can claim the new rewards right away!
4. Position Reservation
- Added a new "by time slot" mode in addition to the existing "by queue" system.

13. Alliance Territory Battle Buff Adjustment: Alliance Territory battle buff will only be active when the battle takes place in a city within the Alliance Territory.

[New Content]
1. New heroes: Gen 8 heroes. Gatot the foreign valiant king, Hendrik the sea-loving captain of the Neptune, and Sonya the money-minded engineer will soon grace the Tundra with their presence and make your Squad more powerful!
2. New feature: Daybreak Island. Search for the legendary Daybreak Island, bring the Tree of Life back to life. Make this island warm again, and it will sure be your new home. (Building shape will change as it is leveled up, this will be available in later update.)
3. New feature: Hero Gear Ascension. Mythic Gear at Enhancement Level 100 can be ascended to Legendary Gear to make your heroes more powerful (available on servers that meet the requirements).
4. New event: Daybreak Expedition. During the event, complete Daily Missions to earn Daybreak Points that can help you level up and unlock more rewards (a one-time event, unlocks at Furnace Lv. 7).

[Optimization & Adjustment]
1. Rally management optimization: R4 and R5 members can now expel allies’ squads in rallies for strategic purposes (excluding Bear Hunt rallies).
2. New Skin Shop item: Mushroom-themed march skin—Mushroom Fairy (Permanent).
3. Mail optimization: Added the notification bubble feature for system mails to make sure you receive all important notices and rewards.
4. Chat optimization: Added the feature that allows alliance officers to mention everyone in alliance chat to facilitate communication.
5. Pet Skills: Pet Skills that do not take effect are hidden in some battlefields.
6. Foundry Battle: Added the “Abstention” option for players who do not wish to participate.
7. Polar Terror: Added Lv. 7 Polar Terror in Wilderness (available on servers that meet the requirements).
8. Weekly & Monthly Cards reward reissuance: Unclaimed rewards for the day you have logged in will be reissued via mail on the next day.
9. Crazy Joe: Added new difficulty Lv. 12 to 21 to provide a more challenging experience and bring more rewards to alliances. (available on servers that meet the requirements)
10. Speedup Weekly Card optimization: Players are no longer required to reach Furnace Lv. 10 to purchase Speedup Weekly Cards.
11. Purchase confirmation: Added a confirmation popup when a large amount of Gems are used to purchase an item and when Gems are used to purchase Loyalty Tags in Enlistment Office.
12. Canyon Clash: Added announcements for the opening of battlefield buildings to keep you in the loop of battlefield updates (available on servers that meet the requirements).
13. Bear Hunt: Added 5 new Personal Damage Reward tiers (Please check in-game rules for more details)
14. State Transfer: Raising the upper limit for each tier of the Transfer Power
15. Interface and stability optimization: Optimized the display of some interfaces and fixed existing bugs to ensure the game runs smoothly.

[New Content]
1. New event: Colorful Easter. The annual Easter festival is here, yet the Rainbow Paints used to paint Easter Eggs are scattered across the Tundra. Please collect these Rainbow Paints and paint Easter Eggs to brighten up this Easter with the most dazzling colors. Enjoy Easter-exclusive missions and rewards, and don’t miss out on Easter-exclusive Skins, Emotes, and more!
2. New feature: Canyon Clash. The explorers have discovered a Frozen Citadel in the canyon. There are mysterious, undeciphered texts that seem to hold the key to saving the world. To claim exclusive ownership of the Frozen Citadel, three alliances meet head-on with their elite troops, ready for an epic battle. Who will stand as the final winner in this contest of honor, wealth, and ancient secret?
3. New Pet: Snow Ape. The town’s growth and your increasing skill in beast taming gives you enough experience to tame a larger beast! Go out into the Wilderness to capture one!

[Optimization & Adjustment]
1. Self-private chat: You can now make notes by sending messages to yourselves.
2. Friend alias: Set aliases for your friends to better manage and identify your friends.
3. Chat search: The private chat list now has a search function that helps you find the right conversation quickly.
4. Pet Auto Refine: Upgrading Pets is now more efficient with this new feature.
5. Alliance label limit adjustment: Increased the limit to 10 labels to meet more customization needs.
6. Foundry Battle optimization: Added the function to send voting notifications and battle request invites to multiple members at one time and voted members will be able to identify members who have voted for the same time slot.
7. New items in Skin Shop: Fantasy Mushroom Avatar Frame and Nameplate.
8. New Emote: Use the new free Emote— Roll A Die—to make chatting more fun!
9. Tundra Adventure’s rule adjustment: During State Transfer, you will be able to keep your Adventure Coins if Tundra Adventure is ongoing in your target State.
10. Hero Gear Enhancement optimization: You can now hold the “Quick Select” button for a more convenient experience.
11. Alliance Vote improvement: Increased the max voting options to 10.
12. Optimized XI Tier Helios Troop: Helios Infantry, Lancer, Marksman now has improved stats.
13. Fixed existing bugs to ensure a more stable and smooth gaming experience for you.

[New Content]
1. New event: Ramadan events - Participate in the events for a chance to obtain Epic Hero Jasser's emote, Mythic Hero Shards, and Training Speedups.
2. New feature: Skin Shop - Complete daily missions to earn exclusive Skin Tokens that can be used to redeem your preferred Skins at the Skin Shop!
3. New feature: Character deletion - Characters can now be deleted (up to 10 characters for one account).
4. New feature: Prestige Shop - After unlocking Prestige Shop, you can use your extra VIP Points to exchange for rare items.

[Optimization & Adjustment]
1. Original text of chat translation is now visible.
2. Replay is now available for Arena battles.
3. Added the Enhancement Reforge and Mastery Reforge features. Gear Enhancement and Mastery Level can be reset to 0. All Enhancement XP spent will be returned for Enhancement Reforge, while 50% of the Essence Stones spent will be returned for Mastery Reforge.
4. Optimized mail interface, allowing easy navigation between previous and next messages.
5. Mythic Gear of Mastery Level less than or equal to 10 can now be used as Mastery materials.
6. 50% of your excess Alliance Arsenal Points earned from Foundry Battle buildings will be contributed to your Alliance (these points are not lost) and the other 50% will count toward the Defense Arsenal Points.
7. During the State of Power event, the Invader’s castle will be marked by red icons on the map.
8. Presidents and Supreme Presidents can change their Position Perks to the buffs of any other Minister during their term.
9. Adjusted the participation requirements for Fortress Battle. Chiefs who are Alliance Members at 00:00 on the day of Fortress Battle can participate. Members are allowed leave the Alliance on the day of Fortress Battle. They can continue to participate in the event if they return to the original Alliance but not if they join another Alliance.
10. Fixed the issue where the option to use Stamina items automatically is enabled by default but does not take effect during Auto Hunting.
11. Chiefs can now check whether there are other Chiefs gathering resources at resource points on the map.
12. Ally Treasures from Pet Adventures will not appear on the Alliance Channel.
13. Added the batch selection feature for Super Refinement in Crystal Laboratory.
14. Optimized the damage algorithm in Bear Hunt to make sure the damage dealt is more consistent.

[New Content]
1. New Event: New Year — Collect lanterns full of wishes and receive New Year's gifts!
2. New Event: Valentine’s Day — Love is in the air, cupid is here on the tundra! Participate in the celebration of lovers to win bountiful rewards such as exclusive skin and emote!
3. New Heroes: Gen 7 Heroes are coming to the tundra — Puppeteer Edith, Gunner Samuel and Alchemist Gordon are coming!
4. New Features: Alliance Glory Rating — Mark your glory against enemies! Reach higher rating to unlock new flags for your alliance!

4. Optimized the Friends system, Chiefs may set Furnace level requirements for sending private messages or friend requests.
5. Optimized the Alliance Voting system, R5/R4 members can view the list of members who have not yet voted, also introduced a notification system to notify members not yet voted.
6. Improved the Crystal Laboratory, more refinement will be available as Fire Crystal Level rises.

8. Consumptions in Foundry Battle are now counted in event missions.
9. Chiefs can now adjust the ratio of troop types to be dispatched. Interfaces such as the battle report can now display the ratio.
10. Optimized the button placement for Hero Recruitment, swapping the position of "Recruit 10 times" and "Use All".
11. Optimized the display for foldable phones.

app.streetleaguefootball.n:
NEW
- Rated 1 ON 1 Route Battles: ranked online games against one player, free and unlimited, with divisions from Iron to Hall of Fame. Rated games need a sign-in.
- Online lots, all on the Downtown Lot field. A party page shows 3D player cards. Join friends by code and play Ball Hog and drills together.
- 500, a jump-ball mode, offline and online.
- Online games replay touchdowns and big hits. Skip to get your player back.
- Name tags in lots, over the head or at the feet.
- On Legend and Insane, CPUs learn how you play. CPU receivers mix up their routes. Endless and 3 on 3 bring a new opponent every 4 rounds.
- Loose cloth: a baggy tee and baggy sweats. Shirts and pants move and clip less.
- Locker: helmet trim color, a color wheel on controller and a Premium skull pendant.
- Premium launch deal: the Founder's Watch, Gold Foil Gloves and the FOUNDER title. Plus a new Premium screen.
- Hit force meter.
- Toe-tap sideline catches.
- Pro QB aiming, on touch too.
- A new intro with the crest, and updated music.

PHONES
- Hold CONTROL while a pass is in the air to stay turned to the ball, then jump or dive. Tap CONTROL to let go.
- The ARM button shows the one-hand glyph while the ball is in the air.
- Pre-snap defense controls on touch.

FIXES
- Steadier online play: fewer drops, freezes and resyncs, plus security hardening.
- Purchases no longer get stuck, and a failed purchase says why.
- Fixed a crash when quitting.
- Lots on iPhone show the Downtown Lot instead of the rooftop.
- Tuned catching, tackling, running and CPU play. The CPU stays in bounds.
- Faster menus and lots.

[Optimizations & Adjustments]
1. Fishing Tournament: Added Seaweed Guide, which will unlock automatically once the requirements are met. Increase your collection progress to earn a limited Chat Skin. Once the specified progress is met, a 10x option will be added to Power Cast, and the initial Fishing Kit will start at max level for better efficiency. Added Seasonal Missions that let you earn Fishing Points and claim valuable Island Decorations. Also added Claim All for rewards and improved Bait descriptions.
2. Governor Avatar: Now you can tap another Governor's avatar in their Governor Profile to view the high-resolution version. If you don't want other Governors to view your high-resolution avatar, go to "Settings - Governor Avatar" to change this setting. Note: You must upload your avatar again after the update to enable this feature. When uploading a custom avatar, a "Preview Avatar Frame" option will be added to the confirmation pop-up. This lets you choose whether to display your current Avatar Frame when previewing your avatar.
3. Formation: Added 4 formations that unlock progressively based on Town Center Level, giving you more options for squad strategies.
4. Alliance: Alliance Notice now supports default Chat Emotes for more expressive messages. Improved the display of Alliance screen so the full content of Alliance Notice is easier to view. Added a draft feature for scheduled notices. If you leave the screen without confirming the schedule, your latest text will be saved automatically.
5. Alliance Vote: Added a vote draft feature that automatically saves your latest text when you leave the editing screen. When starting a vote, you can now select which member ranks are eligible to participate, giving you more flexibility when managing votes.
6. Alliance War: Added an option to enable or disable reminders for event Intel. Initiator Level in Filter Setting can now be selected from a list instead of entered manually, and Truegold Level is now displayed. Added an option to mute Battle Notification pushes to reduce distractions.
7. Oasis Island: Maxing out the Fountain of Life unlocks new missions in Explore Island. Complete the specified requirements to claim rewards, including a new Avatar Frame, Nameplate, and Name Card Skin. Maxed decorations now display a Max level label in the Marketplace for easier identification.
8. VIP Page: Added a display for total login days. You can use the toggle to switch between consecutive and total login days.
9. Castle Battle: Added an "Occupation Details" tab to the Turret Details screen. It displays Alliance Occupation Duration Rankings for a clearer view of the battle status. (This optimization will take effect in the next Castle Battle event after the update.)
10. Hero Recruitment: The "Use All" button has been changed to "Multi Recruit". You can now select the number of recruits freely.
11. Chat: Added an unread-message red dot to the "R4 & R5" management channel so you can see new messages at a glanc

[New Content]
1. Kingdom of Power Optimizations:
Introducing "Duel of the Elites"—a new Cross-Kingdom group battle during the Preparation Phase! The top 150 Governors by Power from each Kingdom will clash in an epic showdown, competing to earn Preparation Point Boosts for their Kingdom and help secure the ultimate victory! (Please refer to the in-game rules for the official event rules.)
2. New Event: Blizzard Brawl
Warriors, assemble! The brawl begins! Whether competing in Same-Gen or Cross-Gen matches, you'll face off against other Governors on a dynamic battlefield and experience thrilling real-time combat. Strategy and execution are equally important—victory or defeat can be decided in an instant. Step onto the battlefield, prove your skill, and claim ultimate glory!

[Optimizations & Adjustments]
1. Alliance Optimizations:
- R5 members can now add or remove Alliance members from the whitelist on the Alliance Members screen, making member management more convenient.
- Manual input has been added to the Alliance Resource Exchange screen for more convenient exchanges.
- A Starred Notice feature and a Starred Notice tab have been added to Alliance Notices, making it easier for Governors to quickly find important notices.
- Notices can now be pinned to make important information more prominent.
- A Like/Dislike option has been added. When enabled, Alliance members can react to notices with likes or dislikes, making feedback more visible.
- Mail notifications have been added for failed gathering attempts at Secured Alliance Gathering Node, providing more timely feedback.
- Once the Kingdom reaches the required progress, the "Claim All" button will remain permanently displayed on the Alliance Gift screen for easier claiming.
2. Position Optimizations:
- To further improve the Position system, a new "By Time Slot" reservation mode has been added alongside the existing "By Queue" mode for the King or High King to choose from. When "By Time Slot" is enabled, Governors can reserve Positions for specific time slots within the next 24 hours. (This feature will take effect after the first new King is crowned following the update.)
- The King or High King can enable automatic approval for reservation applications and set the minimum Town Center Level required to apply for Positions, making management more convenient.
- Position Reservation Task List display improvement: when a Governor reserves different Positions across multiple time slots, each reservation will be displayed separately in the Task List for greater clarity.
- A Position Application Blocklist has been added, allowing the King or High King to prevent specific Governors from applying for Positions, providing greater flexibility in Position management.
3. Rally Optimizations:
- Rally march queues now support a quick left-swipe action, allowing Rally Squads to be recalled more easily.
- When joining a Rally, the March Speedup screen now displays the Rally preparation countdown, making it easier

[New Content]
1. New Feature: The Prestige Shop has been fully upgraded, and the brand-new Prestige Merit Shop is now available! The Ageless Voidstar Skin Series has been upgraded, with new rally skins and other deluxe skins added. After completing the Ageless Voidstar Puzzle, you can also obtain an exclusive domain effect and Prestige Pouch for an even more premium experience.
Successfully unlocking the Skin Series will trigger a server-wide announcement to showcase your extraordinary honor!

[New Content]
1. New Feature: Master System — Quinn sets off on an adventure once again! Accept Governor commissions and face all kinds of challenges on a journey through the Badlands, seeking out Masters who can help build and develop your Town. After you befriend a Master, they will head to the Master Academy in your Town to share their knowledge, offering courses across multiple fields and providing lasting support for Town development and your Kingdom's journey. (Unlocks after your Kingdom reaches the required progress.)
2. March Skin Optimization: Governors can enable up to 6 different March Skins. These skins will be displayed randomly or in sequence based on your settings, offering more variety when switching appearances.

[New Content]
1. Bear Hunt
- New Rewards: New personal damage achievement rewards have been added. Governors participating in Bear Hunt can now earn new rewards based on their historical total damage.
- Note: This optimization takes effect after the update. Damage dealt to the "Raging Bear" before the update will not be counted.
- Auto-Trap Scheduling: A new feature automatically starts the next Bear Hunt action after the cooldown ends, based on the last activation time.

[New Content]
1. New Feature: Governor Gear and Charm Material Exchange
- Governors can exchange excess materials in the Gear interface for Gear and Charm-related items. Make good use of resources and boost your power! (Becomes available when Kingdoms reach a certain progress).

[Optimizations & Adjustments]
1. Alliance:
- Added a new Whitelist feature. Whitelisted Governors will skip the application process and join the Alliance on applying.

[New Content]
1. New Feature: Governor Gear and Charm Material Exchange
- Governors can exchange excess materials in the Gear interface for Gear and Charm-related items. Make good use of resources and boost your power! (Becomes available when Kingdoms reach a certain progress).

[Optimizations & Adjustments]
1. Alliance:
- Added a new Whitelist feature. Whitelisted Governors will skip the application process and join the Alliance on applying.

[New Content]
1. New Feature: Mystic Trial. A brand-new adventure awaits!
2. New Feature: Leading Glory. During Kingdom Transfer, your Kingdom will receive a Leading Emblem each time it qualifies as a Leading Kingdom. Accumulate Leading Emblems to unlock special Leading Glory skins. Show off your Kingdom's dominance!
3. New Feature: Mood Status. Set a status to let others know how you're feeling, making social interactions more fun and personal.

[New Content]
1. New Event: Tri-Alliance Clash. Get ready for the intense showdown among three Alliances! What does it take to dominate the ever-changing battlefield? Teamwork is the key to glory and wealth!
2. New Event: Kingdom Transfer. You can now seek greater fame and fortune in other Kingdoms! During the event, you can transfer to other Kingdoms that meet the requirements.
3. New Feature: Added a second trap in Bear Hunt to ensure more Governors can participate in the event! The two traps can't be set simultaneously. During the cooldown, you won't be able to join either trap. Additionally, Alliance Damage Rewards have been cancelled and consolidated into Personal Damage Rewards.
4. New Feature: Included Alliance Auto-Help in the Ultra Value Monthly Card, allowing you to automatically assist your allies while online!

[Optimization & Adjustment]
1. Swordland Showdown: Increased your initial free March Speedups to 5, with each recovered every 1 minute, and the capacity increased to 30. With enhanced scouting efficiency, you will gather enemy intel faster.
2. Bear Hunt: Upgraded Personal Damage Rewards. The cooldown will reset at UTC 00:00 on the 2nd natural day after participation, and the countdown begins immediately once you start earning points .
3. Viking Vengeance: You will receive more comprehensive battle reports via mail. Added a "Claim All" button, allowing you to claim your Defense Point Rewards more conveniently. You can use the "View Members" feature for more efficient deployments.
4. Oasis Island: Added a "Like History" feature that shows the details of the likes you have received. After the update, you will be able to select multiple vegetations at once. Added a new basic decoration, "Meadow," to bring vibrancy and life to your island. When selecting certain decorations above Lv. 1, a "Dismantle" button will appear.
5. Chat: You will be able to recall messages within a certain time after sending. Added a "Help" button to the World and Alliance Channels so you can help your allies more quickly.
6. Missions: Added new Daily Missions—"Dispatch Pets to hunt for treasure 1 time in Pet Adventure" and "Dispatch Pets to hunt for treasure 4 times in Pet Adventure." Please note that the above optimizations will only take effect after the update. If you complete the above missions before the update, you won't be able to receive the corresponding rewards.
7. Hero-Related Features: Added generation labels for heroes beyond Gen 3 in the Heroes and Hero Details interfaces. Added left and right buttons to the Hero Ascension interface, allowing you to switch heroes more easily.
8. Deployment: Added a "UTC Time" button to the deployment interface when you hold a rally against the Towns of other Governors, Alliance Banners, Alliance HQs, Outposts, Sanctuaries, Fortresses, King's Castles, or Turrets, helping you better plan rally times. By default, your soldiers will be evenly distributed across all soldier types, ensuring a more balanced formation

[New Content]
1. New Gameplay: Oasis Island — Your ship is ready. Awaiting your command, Governor! Set sail for the legendary Oasis Island and build your new home! (Update to the latest version to play)
2. New Event: Alliance Brawl — The strongest alliances vie for power. Only through unity can mighty enemies be defeated. Join forces with your allies and lead your alliance to the ultimate victory! (See in-game calendar for event time)
3. New Event: Merchant Empire — Trade routes are now open. Governors will surely fight for control of these valuable caravans. Escort yours to reap rich rewards. (See in-game calendar for event time)
4. New Feature: Alliance Triumph — A weekly incentive plan has been introduced to reward hardworking Alliance Members. Complete as many Daily and Event missions as possible to earn generous Point Rewards!
5. New Feature: Sanctuary Teleport — A brand-new alliance tech is now available. After research is complete, you can teleport for free to the ruins of the Sanctuary or Fortress your alliance has registered for during the Sanctuary Battle.
6. New Heroes : Fahd, Yeonwoo, and Mikoto — Three Epic Heroes now available via events and recruitment.

[Adjustments and Optimization]
1. Kingdom of Power Optimization
(1) During the Preparation Phase, temporary development buffs are available until the phase ends, helping Governors prepare for the Kingdom of Power.
(2) Hero Shards in Ranking Rewards have been replaced with Combat Award. Governors can now choose Hero Shards or Lucky Hero Gear Chests.
2. Oasis Island-related Rewards: Rewards have been added to Kingdom of Power, Strongest Governor, Armament Competition, Officer Project, Grow your heroes, Defeat nearby beasts and All Out.
3. Resources Gathering Optimization: Search Area expanded and refresh time for gathered but undepleted nodes reduced to make gathering easier for Governors.
4. Arena Optimization: Introduced bulk purchase option for Challenge Attempts. It now displays recommended power, improving the overall experience.
5. Drop Reward Display Optimization: Introduced reward display. You now can view detailed drop info for activities such as attack on beasts, rally on terrors and Beast Hunting in Intel Missions.)
6. Stamina Acquisition Optimization: Added a quick-claim feature in the Stamina interface.
7. Gem Shop Optimization: Added General Speedups, Advanced Teleporter, and more items.
8. Infirmary Optimization: Healing Injured soldiers on the World Map now opens a popup instead of a full-screen interface.
9. Alliance Notice Optimization: The Alliance Notice popup now supports translation.
10. Alliance War List Optimization: New filter feature allows Governors to customize notification display.
11. Chat Optimizations:
(1) New Chat Draft feature now saves your input when switching channels or closing the chat window.
(2) Unvoted Notices now get reminders in Alliance Chat and the Voting Bar can be expanded or collapsed.
(3) Alliance Notice interface now shows announceme

[New Content]
1. New Event: Kingdom of Power—Sound the battle horn and join the ultimate clash of kings. Win the supreme glory for your kingdom! Exclusive skins are also waiting for you!
2. New Event: Strongest Governor—Fight against governors across kingdoms for glory on the Honor Ranking and bountiful rewards.
3. New Pets: Now you may tame Bison, Moose, Lion, Grizzly Bear as pets in the wild! Tame them to get the variety of skills and power boost.
4. New Feature: Skin Shop—Angry Cactus, House of Cacti, Desert Flower Avatar Frame and more are available to redeem for free. Complete daily missions for skin token and get your favorite skins!
5. New Feature: Action Emotes—New action emotes brings more fun to social interactions with other governors. You may get more through different events!
6. New age has dawn: Age of Truegold has arrived, Truegold will be the key to new reign! Gather enough Truegold and upgrade your Town Center, military and other buildings to Truegold buildings, use Truegold weapon to gear up your soldiers and become a stronger governor!
7. New Event: Golden Glaives—Missions in the Watchtower grants you extra Dim Goldstones, which are used to redeem for Truegold, speedups, and more rare items.

[Optimization & Adjustment]
1. Arena Rewards Optimization: Improved ranking rewards, increased the number of reward receivers, giving more governors the opportunity to get rewarded.
2. Hall of Governor Rewards Optimization: Improved ranking rewards, increased the number of reward receivers, giving more governors the opportunity to get rewarded.
3. Event Rewards Optimization: Improved ranking rewards for Plan your City, Working Overtime, Power up, Defeat nearby beasts, All Out, Develop new tech and more, increased the number of reward receivers, giving more governors the opportunity to get rewarded.
4. Top-up Gift: Introduced new reward tier for cool march skin. Governors who have already satisfy the requirements may claim it right away.
5. Conquest Battle Optimization: Enabled quick battle for governors who have cleared stage 30 when the total power of the hero deployed doubles that of the enemy's.
6. Watchtower Battle Optimization: Enabled Conquest Intel quick battle for governors who have cleared stage 30 in the Conquest Battle.
7. Conquest Battle Power Display Optimization: Adjusted and optimized the enemy power displayed in conquest battle, making it more accurate and reasonable.
8. Rally Optimization: Introduced skill display for rally captain's exclusive gear, now displays the ratio of different soldier type.
9. Hero Gear Optimization: Optimized hero gear stats display, enhancing their stats and governor's strength.
10. Milestone Optimization: Introduced milestone rewards for Cultural Rebirth, giving exclusive rewards to governors reaching Lv. 30 Town Center.
11. Skin Optimization: Optimized the animation for "Abyssal City" town skin and "Great Golden Glutton" march skin.
12. Governor Charm Optimization: Optimized the icons for Gover

com.innersloth.amongus.n: Ad rewards have increased! Redeem up to three Stars in a single day (supported countries and full accounts only.)

Update v19.0.0 brings a brand new Ghost Crewmate role to assist the living - the Influencer.
Message ability: send clues from beyond the grave to help catch the Impostor(s).
Spookiness is in full effect with map decorations, Trick and Treat Cosmicubes, and the 2019 Halloween Bundle coming this October!

ALL RISE!

Update to v18.0.0 so you can play as our brand new Crewmate role - the Judge!
Overrule Ability: Choose a Crewmate to eject no matter who's been voted for. Choose wisely - if they aren't the Impostor you get ejected instead! Complete tasks to enable your ability during meetings.
Use the new Match Info Guide so you can keep track of players, roles, and match settings during a game.
The Detective's Interrogate ability now has a cooldown after Emergency Meetings.

OUR ANIMATED SHOW IS FINALLY HERE!

Update to v17.4.0 and celebrate the Among Us Animated Show with a new Cosmicube and decorations from it placed around The Skeld. You can watch the show on Paramount+.

New Showbiz Cosmicube for 4000 Beans.
New Cosmic Cosmicube for 70 Stars.
Celebrate 8 years of Among Us on June 15th with a present from us to you.

And don't forget to check out all the news on our brand new game, Among Us Story: On Guard!

Read about it all at innersloth.com.

- Daily cap for ad rewards is now bumped up to 2 (in available countries)
- Crashes on mobile from previous update are fixed

Is it just us, or did the Crewmates get older? For 17.3.0, enjoy our new April Fools event:

- Nostalgia Mode: From April 1 - April 8, play Among Us as it originally looked! Sprites, some cosmetics, and even the old Emergency Meeting calls. You can turn this mode on/off in the lobby creation menu.
Minor bug fixes

Hold it! We hope you don't have any objections to update 17.2.0, which comes with a cosmetic drop.

Log in to receive these items from our new collab with Ace Attorney:

- Phoenix Wright's Hair
- Phoenix Wright's Suit

Also look forward to a brand new limited time Cosmicube coming next month!

Hold it! We hope you don't have any objections to update 17.2.0, which comes with a cosmetic drop.

Log in to receive these items from our new collab with Ace Attorney:

- Phoenix Wright's Hair
- Phoenix Wright's Suit

Also look forward to a brand new limited time Cosmicube coming next month!
Bug fixes
Optional ad rewards are now available. For more information, check our website.

Wake up Crewmates, new update just dropped.

v17.1.0 features:

- [NEW] Stardew Valley Cosmicube: Retire to the farm (to do more tasks) in our newest collaboration! Get it before it withers away on Feb 18, 2026 for 3300 Beans.
- Create Game screen: Backgrounds have been updated to reflect the map chosen. Enjoy!
-  Make sure you log in near the end of the year to retrieve our celebratory 2026 cosmetics. Where did the time go???
Bug fixes

GET TO WORK!

A free update (v17.0.0) is out now featuring:

 - [NEW] Crewmate role: DETECTIVE. Interrogate Crewmates, reveal locations, and solve murders.

 - [NEW] Impostor role: VIPER. Dissolve slowly corpses with acid to escape suspicion.

 - Quality of life updates to accommodate all the roles.

 - Small bug fixes when using the inventory and Crewmate color selection

Happy 7th Birthday to Among Us! We're celebrating with update 16.1.0:
- NEW: Log in for an exclusive free birthday hat (Caked Up) and join the party before it ends on July 22.
- The Skeld is decorated too!
- NEW: More cosmetics have been added to the in-game store. Get them for Beans and show off your hard work in style.
- More exciting drops including the return of a well-loved collab..?! Stay tuned.
Bug Fixes

- Fixed the black screen -> app crash -> long timeout issue
- Updated Matchmaking: A new way to create and find lobbies! Set your filters and find your ideal match. See specific lobby settings before you join them.
- NEW Kamurocho Cosmicube: Be(an) like a dragon with our new Cosmicube collab with RGG Studio! These cosmetics will be gone after June 23, 2025 at 17:00 UTC.
- April Fool's Day is coming. Nothing out of the ordinary could happen... Read about all the changes at innersloth.com.

Time to match up, Crewmates! Update to version 16.0.0 to get:

- Updated Matchmaking: A new way to create and find lobbies! Set your filters and find your ideal match. See specific lobby settings before you join them.
- NEW Kamurocho Cosmicube: Be(an) like a dragon with our new Cosmicube collab with RGG Studio! These cosmetics will be gone after June 23, 2025 at 17:00 UTC.
- April Fool's Day is coming. Nothing out of the ordinary could happen...

Read about all the changes at innersloth.com.

Unleash your inner animal, Crewmates. Update v2024.11.26 is here and it's got hippos, dragons, and raccoons - oh my! Two new animal themed Cosmicubes are available now.

- NEW Paws Cosmicube for 3000 Beans
- NEW Claws Cosmicube for 80 Stars

Both Cosmicubes are permanent additions to our cosmetic lineup so go wild. And as the end of 2024 approaches keep your visors peeled for a gift to celebrate the new year.

Read all about it at innersloth.com.

This is our biggg bug update of the year! Thanks for all of your feedback - it helps improve the game. Make sure you update to v2024.10.29 for these changes:

Trying to start an Online lobby while permanently or temporarily banned will no longer put the game into an endless black screen. Remember to play nice.
Updated the Tracker's ability to display as "TRACK" instead of "TRACKER".
Increased the font size of the settings in the 'View' for players using smaller devices.
The "Room Code Copied" text will now disappear after you copy the room code.
[Lobby] - We lowered the volume of The Skeld song in the lobby. Sorry it was too loud!
[Lobby] - The friends list icon no longer moves when accepting a game invite.
[Lobby] - Chat bubbles shouldn't break through the chat window when scrolling.
[Lobby] - The visor and hat on the host icon are now layered correctly.
[Lobby] - Hats now layer correctly when stacking with other players on the Dropship.
[Lobby] - Fixed layering issues for chat in multiple windows.
[Lobby] - Fixed inconsistent fonts being displayed for special characters.
[Lobby] - Game setting updates now display with the correct icons and colors when popping up on the left side of the screen.
[Lobby] - The plus and minus buttons in the role settings will continue to work after you select a game preset.
[Lobby] - The plus and minus buttons in the role settings no longer stay highlighted after selecting them.
[Classic] - Button click SFX no longer occurs when you click the map icon during the start of a game.
[Practice] - The practice dummies will now respawn after calling an Emergency Meeting.
[Airship / Fungle] - Visors are layered correctly during ladder animations.
[Skeld / Polus] - We removed a controller button icon that appeared during the Inspect Samples task even if you weren't using a controller.
[Fungle] - Crewmates are no longer be frozen in the climbing animation if a Mushroom Mixup is called while on the ladder.

Time to raise your objections, Crewmates! Our collab with Ace Attorney Investigations Collection is now live.

Log in before October 9, 2024 at 7am UTC to receive these free cosmetics:
Miles Edgeworth's Coif
Miles Edgeworth's Suit
- Internal bug fixes

Epic adventures await with an all new collab. Here's what's in v2024.8.13:

- NEW Critical Role collab: Choose your role with Gilmore's Curious Cosmicube. Get it before it disappears from the in-game store on November 12!
- NEW exclusive kill animation: Witness the brand new Chetney kill when wearing their cosmetics from the Gilmore's Curious Cosmicube.
- Bug fixes to the lobby rework.

Our new roles have arrived, Crewmates! Here's what's in v2024.6.18:

    NEW ROLE: Tracker. Plant a tracking device on anyone and see if people are really where they say they are.
    NEW ROLE: Noisemaker. When killed, emit an alert to everyone. Your death may expose the truth!
    NEW ROLE: Phantom: Turn invisible and make your escape after executing a kill.
    Revamped Lobby Settings: The giant list of settings has been changed into a clean new menu to view when joining a lobby
    Lobby music added to the Dropship

Crewmates! We have updates for v2024.6.4:
- It's our birthday month! Log in on June 15 for a special gift and celebrate with us
- New cosmetics added to the Bean Store
- Localization fixes

Added Auto-Translate. You can turn it on or off in chat.

Claiming Wagon rewards now collects rewards from all arrived Wagons at once.
Improved some building descriptions to better reflect their functions.
New VIP 18 Perks are now available! Visit the VIP Perks page to view details.

Introducing the Royal Title system! (Follow updates in your in-game Mail for details.)
Optimized the [Race to Ace] event screen.

Added prerequisite building upgrade prompts for Castle Lv.10 or below. From there, you can go directly to the specific building upgrade.

English, Japanese, and Korean voice-overs have been added, including main story and most Hero voice lines.
Added a [Voice] option that allows you to change the voice language without changing the game's display language. English, Japanese, and Korean use their respective voice languages by default. German does not have a default voice language. All other display languages default to English voice.

New [Scheduled Auto-Siege] feature added.
Added a quick-upgrade shortcut to the pre-battle lineup edit screen. Tap it to open the upgrade menu.
Added new [Congratulate All] feature when there are 5 or more pending congratulations, you can complete them all by tapping [Cheers].

Added Speedup Refund feature: When using Finish in the Speed Up menu, any excess time from the speedups used will be sent via Mail as corresponding 1m speedup items.
[Hot Deals - Calendar] now includes events previews for [Tusk Hunt] and [Imperial Supply Raid].

Added [Lineup Presets] and [Lineup Restore] features:
Added Claim All feature for all Intel Task rewards. Unlock condition: Intel Lv.7.
Added [Sanada Yukimura] and [Saladin] to Recruitment Pool. Unlock condition: 91 days after the Kingdom opens.

New hero appearance for [Joan of Arc]
Tap the points bubble in top-up events to view your current points progress, then tap the chest icon inside the bubble to view item reward details.
Adjusted VIP17 Exclusive Pack contents and added the new Castle Effect: Holy Flameblade.
Minor bug fixes and performance improvements. Have fun!

Knights can issue daily City Decrees and weekly City Tasks on behalf of the City Lord.
City Lords and Knights can collect taxes from Lords of equal or lower rank in other Alliances whose Cities are within the range of the Cities they manage.

New in-game language support added: Arabic, Turkish, and Polish.
