1. The Astral Alignment Party is coming soon! Celebration signals travel across the stars, and anniversary salutes light up the party night! Tour the Port celebrations together and enjoy a galaxy of rewards, events, and surprises!
2. A new Sunday stage, Stand Down, is introduced to the Commerce Guild Duel. Complete the designated quests to earn rewards based on the losses sustained by your Commerce Guild's combat craft during the Duel Day.
3. A new ground combat event "Amusement Park Defense" has been introduced and will alternate with "Kaboom, robots!" from Sunday to Monday. The event will initially be available for testing on servers 1001–1016.
4. Dominion Warzone is coming to S2 servers! Draw lots to determine matchups, battle through elimination rounds, and fight for a higher season ranking for your server!
5. The Android version will use Vulkan as its primary rendering API to improve the gaming experience. The rendering styles of some buildings will also be optimized.
6. Leaderboards will now include rankings for Champion Weapons.
7. The Guild Member list will now support searching by member name.
8. In the S2 Aromabloom Trade War event, the analysis progress of chests obtained from certain Trader Commissions will be doubled.
9. Optimized the level indicators for Flagships at levels 31–35.
10. Optimized the display of in-game red dot notifications.
11. Other optimizations and bug fixes related to Season 2.

1. Increased Commerce Guild Rewards in [Shadowfront].
2. Added [Weapon Prism] to the Discount Shop.
3. Adjusted the unlock requirements for the [Epoch of Fusion Seed] Tech Tree. The required completion progress for the [Combat Craft Modification] Tech Tree has been reduced from 60% to 40%.
4. Optimized Rally List sorting. Rallies initiated by you will now be prioritized and displayed at the top.
5. Improved keyboard shortcuts on the Windows and macOS clients. You can now press Enter to quickly access the chat input field.
6. Enhanced the visual presentation of the Enemy Info interface on the map.
7. Improved the rewards for occupying a port for the first time in S2.
8. Improved the display of acquisition sources and the Quick Use functionality in the item info for [Fusion Seed] and [Stellar Fragment].
9. Fixed several S2-related issues and other bugs.

1. S2 - The Usurper will be available for testing on Servers 1001–1016.
2. The "Shared Moonlight" special operation is coming soon! Though the galaxy stretches far and wide, we all share the same moon. Collect event items, participate in limited-time gameplay events, and earn rare rewards!
3. A new ground combat event "Combat Lab" has been introduced and will begin testing on servers 1001–1016.
4. Ruins Raiders will introduce a cross-server feature, which will be available on servers that have been open for at least 4 weeks.
5. Added a Repair button to the login and settings interfaces. Tap it to automatically repair game resources and resolve issues such as being unable to log in due to corrupted resources.
6. For players with the same Energy Core level, those with greater progress toward the next Energy Core level will rank higher on the Energy Core Leaderboard.

1. Navigation Day - Beacon Fest is coming soon! On the night the trade routes restart, countless lights illuminate the port as traders gather to celebrate the continuation of civilization. Collect event items, join limited-time events, and earn rare rewards!
2. Optimized the application list in the Interstellar Migration event. Reviewers can now view applicants' Commerce Guild and Power information and start a chat with them directly, making it easier to process applications.
3. Optimized the member display order in the Garrison interface. The ship you are currently garrisoning will now appear directly below the Garrison Leader for easier access.
4. Added a display for the amount of Fusion Seeds in the resource section of the Storage interface.
5. Adjusted the UI layering of the Back button in the Storage interface to ensure it remains clickable at certain resolutions.
6. Optimized display compatibility on some foldable devices.
7. Other optimizations and bug fixes.

1. Added Champion-exclusive weapons for "Fist of Luminism - Aliya" and "Warden - Eva Von Trier". These weapons will be available on servers that have been open for at least 27 weeks.
2. Improved the Duel Day experience for the Commerce Guild Duel event. Attacking a War Prism will now automatically remove the Interstellar Shelter status.
3. Optimized the descriptions for Champion Weapon Fragments, which now include the weapon's compatible Champion role and Style.
4. Other optimizations and bug fixes.

Update Highlights:
1. Optimized the duration of the Sacred Tribute Vessel, which is now set to 3 hours.
2. Improved the display of Guild Chest information by removing portrait frames.
3. Other optimizations and bug fixes.

1. Added Stamina and Champion Weapon items to the Discount Shop.
2. Adjusted the duration of the Sacred Tribute Vessel to 30 minutes.
3. Improved the visual effects of ranking information in mail messages.
4. Other optimizations and bug fixes.

Update Highlights:
 1. The "Interstellar Amusement Park" event is coming soon! A galactic fairytale is loading! Bring your childlike wonder and conquer the galaxy! Collect event items, participate in limited-time gameplay events, and earn rare rewards!
 2. The fourth Flagship, "Gungnir" has been released and will become available on servers that have been live for at least 27 weeks.
 3. New entries have been added to the Encyclopedia Galactica, including "Glory Protection" and "Graphics Settings".
 4. Rally Optimizations:
 4.1 Added an "Embark Now" feature.
 4.2 Enhanced the visual effects of the rally bubbles to improve visibility of key rallies.
 4.3 Added new Styles and participant count displays to the rally interface.
 5. Improved the Duel Day experience in the "Commerce Guild Duel" event. War Prisms now have ownership mechanics, and Guild members outside of the competing Commerce Guilds can no longer earn event points by attacking them.
 6. Optimized the logic for the Glory Decay feature. Players with Total Power above 20M will no longer be affected by Glory Decay. Please refer to the Encyclopedia Galactica for more information.

1. The brand-new Flagship "Gungnir" is officially available and will gradually be unlocked according to server progression.
2. The "United Frontline" event will begin testing in selected servers (1001–1024, 1041–1064, 1081–1104).
3. Points Optimizations for the Dominion Warzone Event:
3.1 Significantly reduced the points required for individual progress chests.
3.2 Added the new "Map Search" point quest.
3.3 Added the new "Consume Repair Materials" point quest.
3.4 Greatly increased points earned from "Consume Prismatic Cores".
3.5 Added the new "Destroy Combat Craft" point quest.
3.6 During the "Offense-Defense Contest" stage, a new "Shadowfront Points Comparison" quest will be added on Mondays.
4. Added a new Glory Decay feature. When the power gap between two sides is too large, Glory rewards will now be reduced proportionally.
5. Optimized the challenge experience for Stage 10 of "Battle Trial": Enemy strength in this stage has been moderately reduced to ease completion pressure while maintaining a fair challenge.
6. Optimized fleet management logic for deploying/removing combat craft and Flagships.
7. Fixed the issue where Ascendancy Shrines would fail to attack under certain conditions.
8. Fixed the issue where Flagships would become invisible for some players.
9. Fixed several UI display issues.

1. The "Tender Letters" event will be available soon. Collect fragrant flowers and unlock heartfelt rewards! Share a warm, interstellar moment with someone special.
2. Jodie Béart's classic look is making a comeback—and it's now available as a free permanent unlock!
3. The "Top 100 Galactic Traders" event interface has been fully revamped. A new progress bar animation has been added when earning points, making every milestone in your rise to the top more intuitive and clear.
4. Optimized point rules for the "Paths to Dominance" event: During the event, PvP battles in Lvl 9 star systems will now grant event points.
5. Other optimizations and bug fixes.

1. The "United Frontline" event will be launched as a test in Servers 1001–1023. During the event, the Ascendancy Shrine will stop spawning.
2. Increased the number of uses for Prince's Decrees. Buff effects and cooldowns will no longer reset when the Paths to Dominance event begins on the server. (Bounty effects will still be cleared upon reset.)
3. Optimized the display of Trader Conquerors. Their portraits and names will now correctly appear in the Abyss Region of conquered servers.
4. When any Vault in the Shadowfront enters a Brief Awakening state, 6–9 resource nodes will appear. Collecting them restores HP to the Flagship performing the collection (Minor Damage only).
5. Adjusted the scoring rules for the Commerce Guild Duel: Added point gains for consuming Weapon Prisms on Tuesdays and Fridays, reduced points from Weapon Energy Cores, optimized matchmaking based on unlocked Champion Weapon features, and improved Super Chest opening with a new Quick Open button.
6. Dominion Warzone event adjustments:
6.1 Lowered the daily point requirements during the Preparation Stage.
6.2 Added a new “Warzone Mobilization” event, launching together with the Dominion Warzone.
7. Optimized the ranking display rules in "Kaboom, robots!": When kill counts are tied, rankings are now determined by completion time.
8. Optimized the display of shield-type combat buffs on the main interface.
9. The battle settings have been improved and now include a customizable operation recording feature.
10. Added a close button to scrolling notifications.
11. If the Hangar is full and no craft can be upgraded, the corresponding Shipyard will no longer show build notifications.
12. The Champion Weapon feature now unlocks on the Monday of Week 12 instead of after 90 server days.
13. Optimized the sorting in the Character Management interface: The three most recently logged‑in server characters are now shown first, with all others listed in ascending server order.
14. The search function for "Operation Blackout" has been moved to the main interface for easier access to Tithe Collectors.
15. Improved the display of Garrison Stronghold levels in the “Dominion Warzone” event interface.
16. Adjusted Glory Arena scoring rules: No points will be awarded to either side if a counterattack fails.
17. Fixed display issues on certain devices.
18. Fixed the issue where player names were not displayed in cross-server battlefields.

1. The Spring Wonderland event is coming soon! Spring signals are piercing through the stars, and all things await a new miracle. Collect event items, join limited-time events, and earn rare rewards!
2. The Dominion Warzone event has been expanded to include Servers 1001-1080.
3. Rally system optimizations:
3.1 The post‑battle wait time for fleets that automatically join a rally has been significantly reduced.
3.2 Adjusted default rally timers: removed the 15-minute option and added a 3-minute option.
3.3 Increased the number of Tribute Vessels available in Lvl 8 and 9 star systems.
4. Adjusted the Prince's Commendation rules: only the officially appointed Trader Prince can now grant Prince's Commendations.
5. Optimized the item descriptions for Legendary Champion Fragments.
6. Optimized the Champion Weapon drawing feature and improved the display of weapon fragment information.
7. Fixed display issues with certain UI visual assets.
8. Fixed the issue where cargo ships would appear offset.

1. The "Blossom Promise" event will begin soon. Offer your Wish Slips and join the Blossom Promise to unlock exclusive rewards!
2. The "Dominion Warzone" event will enter a pioneer test stage on servers 1,001–1,010. Fight for glory and conquer the stars!
3. A new Champion Weapon system will be added. This feature unlocks after your server has been online for 90 days and can be accessed via the Eternal Forge.
4. Added a new feature allowing Commerce Guild R4/R5 members to cancel rally deployments initiated by guild members.
5. Added Japanese and Korean language options.
6. Adjusted the "War Frenzy" buff: Flagships affected by War Frenzy can no longer perform star system jumps.
7. Refined the visual design of Agent Jodie.
8. Adjustments to Commerce Guild Disbandment Rules:
8.1 Commerce Guilds that fail to find a match in Commerce Guild Duel can now be disbanded normally.
8.2 Commerce Guilds at Lvl 7 or above now have a daily limit of 50 member removals.
8.3 Commerce Guilds at Lvl 9 or above must remove all members before they can be disbanded.
9. Fixed the issue where certain resource UI elements might display incorrectly when switching scenes.

1. The "Emerald Adventure" event is now available! At the end of the rainbow, luck awaits! Collect event items, join limited-time events, and claim abundant rewards!
2. Added visual atmosphere effects and special effects for the Energy Core in the inner city under states such as Overloaded, Overclocked, and Low Power Mode.
3. Added a preview feature for appearance item effects.
4. Added a new crew member profession: "Network Telemetry Officer, which can be assigned to the Traders Network room.
5. Added Champion Weapon-related point quests in the [Commerce Guild Duel] event (unlocks with server progress).
6. Adjusted the validity duration of Loot Chests obtained by Guild members to 3 days. Other chests obtained through paid sources will remain valid for 7 days.
7. Adjusted the PvP Star System feature. Tribute Vessels will no longer appear in this star system.
8. Fixed the issue where the Firepower Boost VI attribute bonus for "Flagships & Combat Craft was not applied correctly.

1. New rules have been added to the Shadowfront.
1.1 A rapid‑recovery feature is now available in the spawn zone.
1.2 Added descriptions for the Battlefield Mini Map and the Vault's Phase Eruption mechanic.
2. The base points for the Commerce Guild Duel task "Chrono Map Search" have been adjusted to 180,000.
3. Fixed display issues affecting certain chat preview interfaces.
4. Fixed an issue where some Space Event rewards were displayed incorrectly.
5. Fixed an issue where certain ability effects could disappear during Space Combats.

1. New Power System
1.1 Power is generated by the Energy Core and serves as the fundamental resource required for all rooms to operate. Power generation consumes Water.
1.2 Upgrading the Energy Core increases the maximum Power output. As room levels increase, their Power consumption will also rise accordingly.
2. The Valentine's Day-exclusive "Rosebound Journey" event is about to begin! Search for Starlit Roses across the galaxy and let your feelings travel among the stars. Collect and gift Starlit Roses during the event to earn generous rewards!
3. New Gift-Giving Feature: You can now send festival gifts to other traders. Some rare items are also eligible for gifting.
4. New Killstreak Effects: Unlock special full-screen broadcast effects by meeting the required conditions and showcase your dominance on the battlefield! Refer to the "Encyclopedia Galactica" for more details.
5. New Building: The Bulletin Board will be available after unlocking the corresponding building.
6. Resource Bar Optimization: You can now tap the resource bar to customize which resources are displayed in the resource panel.
7. War Frenzy Buff Adjustment: After obtaining the War Frenzy buff, the slow effect duration has been reduced from 60 seconds to 20 seconds.
8. Shadowfront Optimization: Exit restrictions for the Commerce Guild during the Shadowfront event have been adjusted. Players are now restricted from leaving a Commerce Guild on the Battle Day.
9. Improved the loading performance of the ranking interface for a smoother and more responsive experience.
10. Increased the settling limit of a single Port from 150 to 200.
11. Fixed the issue where certain actions in space would cause UI display issues.
12. Fixed the issue where damage could be lost when pursuing enemies during combat.

1. Added a Player Recommendation feature to the Commerce Guild Recruitment interface. Players without a Commerce Guild will be recommended to assist with recruitment each day.
2. Added new Encyclopedia Galactica entries: Rally Up and Interstellar Shelter.
3. Improved Champion list display with a portrait toggle option.
4. Improved the TPS combat control interface and enhanced overall control responsiveness.

1. Christmas Event Series Coming Soon
Stop zoning out in front of the Christmas tree! Join us for the Snowlit Starry Sky — a special part of the Christmas Adventure Season event. During the event period, collect Christmas items, participate in festive challenges, and earn generous holiday rewards!
2. Commerce Guild Optimizations:
2.1 Updated the Commerce Guild interface layout.
2.2 Added internal Commerce Guild leaderboards (Power, Glory, Technology Donations).
2.3 Added Commerce Guild Poll voting announcements and urgent announcements (unlocked via Commerce Guild Technology).
2.4 Added comments and likes for Guild announcements.
2.5 Added a Commerce Guild Log feature to track Guild members' PVP battles on the world map, member changes, and routine management actions.
3. Optimized the Valor Arena leaderboard refresh mechanism to resolve potential lag during refreshes.
4. Fixed the issue where UI layers overlapped incorrectly in certain scenarios when receiving assistance invitations.
5. Other optimizations and bug fixes.

1. Commerce Guild Optimizations:
1.1 Added Assault status prompts during "Port Battles", which can be viewed in the main interface of the Commerce Guild Event.
1.2 Added special tags for mass mail sent by Commerce Guild admins.
2. Introduced the "Shadowfront" event, which will undergo a pioneer test on servers 1001-1022.
3. Valor Shop: Added Lily Champion Fragments.

1. New "Defend the Trade Route" Settlement Chests: At the end of the event, 0 to 3 chests will now drop in the event area based on your progress. These chests will appear near the planets that your trade ship most recently passed and must be collected manually.
2. Improved the visual effects for space interactions to enhance overall game performance.
3. Adjusted the battle report logic to ensure that reports regarding combat craft losses are not hidden.
4. Enhanced the visual effects and interactive experience of the Flagship Promotion and Upgrade interfaces.
5. Improved connection stability when switching the game between foreground and background, ensuring smoother performance during multitasking.
6. Optimized the reward distribution for Rally Battles: participating troops will still receive rewards if the rally is victorious, even if they are defeated.

Update Log:
1. Optimized room construction effects and Flagship 3D assets to improve overall game performance.
2. Improved notification prompts for Research and Shipbuilding queues during room upgrades.
3. Reduced the refresh interval for the Ascendancy Shrine's teleport count from 30 minutes to 3 minutes.
4. Fixed the issue where the room interface would become misaligned after switching scenes.
5. Other optimizations and bug fixes.

This update focuses on improving combat mechanics and overall gaming experience. The key adjustments are as follows:

1. [War Frenzy] Mechanism Adjustments
• Fleets that initiate attacks against other traders will enter the [War Frenzy] status, gaining increased Attack and applying a Slow effect to targets. Fleets in this status cannot teleport, be recalled, or be repaired. The duration resets if the status is triggered again.
• Leaving a rally or garrison during War Frenzy will temporarily prevent you from rejoining.
• Removed the special War Frenzy and Slow effect when flanked in the "Disciple Hunting Grounds" event. Future events will now uniformly apply the standard [War Frenzy] mechanics.

2. Port Garrison Improvements
• Garrisoned fleets now have a default Defense bonus.
• When any fleet garrisoned at a Port triggers [War Frenzy], all fleets garrisoned at that Port will receive the [War Frenzy] bonus.

3. New [Home Port Logistics] Feature
• When not engaged in combat, fleets at your Home Port reduce Major Damage over time.

4. Reporting System Launch
• You can now report in-game violations such as inappropriate names, custom avatars, and chat content.

5. Daily Quest Simplification
• Reduced progress requirements, making rewards easier to obtain.

6. Visual Enhancements
• Optimized certain visual assets and UI elements to improve the overall experience.
- A few bugs fixed.

[New Character - Nero] Be careful not to enter and get lost in the dream space this dreamsmith creates.
[New Weapon - Winchester] A full-auto marksman rifle with 2-round firing and high mobility, an excellent pick for long‑range combat.
[Social Island in Custom Room] Create your own hangout and invite friends to party together.

[NARUTO SHIPPUDEN Collaboration Chapter 2] Bermuda is under the influence of Tsukuyomi—venture into the affected areas and explore! Akatsuki keepsakes have arrived, featuring the special abilities of Akatsuki members so you can relive thrilling, action-packed battles. The Hidden Leaf Village is under attack, with a giant Planetary Devastation sphere hanging in the sky!
[New Character - Rin] A swift ninja who summons kunai to fight around her.

[New Map: Solara] Featuring spectacular twin peaks and an exciting slide system, this map offers rich combat strategies and exploration!
[8th Anniversary] The Infinity Train invites every brave Survivor to join the journey!
[Camera System] Use various camera tools to create unique memories with friends!
[Free Custom Room] All players can freely create and host custom rooms!
[Prime System] To thank players for their support, Prime grants exclusive privileges and rewards based on past top-ups.

[MyZone] Make the BR battlefield your zone with the event's workshops!
[Device Item] More items can now fit into the device slot, and the user experience has been improved.
[Lone Wolf] Teammate matching is now available, and the map design has been improved.
[New Character - Oscar] Oscar can catch his enemies off guard by using the extraordinary power of his battle suit to break through their defenses.

[Winterlands: Aurora] Winterlands brings new Aurora Events and the Frosty Machines.
[Frosty Track] Glide along Bermuda's tracks for swift travel and thrilling combat encounters.
[Map Update] Bermuda is blanketed in snow, with the Clock Tower adorned with colorful lights, snowmen, and more!
[New Character - Koda] Koda can locate enemies behind cover and swiftly chase them down.
[New Weapon - M590] A new single-shot shotgun with explosive rounds that deal area damage.

[Gloo Nova] Bermuda is covered in gloo! Equip the new Gloo Gadgets to boost your battles!
[Map Update] The Factory in Bermuda is now filled with gloo. Use its unique properties to your advantage!
[New Character - Lila] Lila can decelerate enemies and vehicles with a rifle, and if she knocks down a slowed enemy, she receives an extra Gloo Wall.
[Profile Update] The Profile Page is now customizable. Show off your favorite content and create a unique profile!

[BR Update] Mini Peak will appear in the BR sky! Land there and grab powerful Nostalgic Weapons.
[CS Update] Mini Peak will appear in random rounds in CS.
[CS: FPP] A new first-person perspective CS mode is now available.
[Cosmic Racer] A brand new flying vehicle has joined the battle!
[New Character - Kassie] This neuroscientist can connect with teammates and continuously restore their health.
[Armory Update] Introducing the Gunsmith system and an update on weapon attributes display.

[Dragon Conqueror (BR)] Villains have invaded Bermuda. Annihilate them and conquer the Mechadrake.
[Dragon Airdrop (CS)] Defeat the flying Mechadrake to loot rare supplies.
[New Character - Kairos] The former Special Forces soldier consumes EP to break his foes' armor.
[Improved Combat Feedback] More instant feedback to celebrate the little victories on the battlefield!

[New event - The Chaos] Vote for bizarre incidents to take place in the matches, including out-of-control plane routes and genetically modified mushrooms!
[NexTerra 2.0] Map-balancing adjustments and significant file size reduction. Zipway reworked and added to CS-Ranked.
[New Character - Ryden] The genius releases a robot spider that limits enemy movement and inflicts damage over time.
[Improved battle feedback] Enhanced the sound effects for knockdown streaks and visual effects for headshots.

[Guild 2.0] Play matches with guildmates to level up your guild and earn rewards!
[Guild Wars] Put your teamwork and fighting skills to the test against other guilds.
[Battle Royale Adjustments] More ways to earn FF Coins and better economy balance. New items to assist your battles.
[Snow in Bermuda] On top of blankets of snow, water surfaces on the island have turned into ice for diverse fighting experiences.
[New Character - Ignis] Forms a flaming screen that obstructs view and burns enemies.

[New Mode] Zombie Hunt mode returns with a bigger map, more monsters, and enhanced buffs!
[Peak Rework] Bermuda's Peak has undergone major changes and the area will now be available in Clash Squad.
[New Character] Suzy will earn you in-match currency for your eliminations.
[Clash Squad] Loot the Cyber Airdrop for rarer equipment.
[Battle Royale] Capture the Defense Arsenal and try out Solo Dare, a new revival method.
[Training Grounds] Reworked Target Range for more effective training sessions.

[New mode] Brand new, time-limited Duo Active Skills mode in CS-Ranked.
[New system] Achievement system now live. Celebrate your accomplishments!
[Quick Messages] Customize your list of quick messages.
[Character Awakening] Alok "the Booyah Man".
[New character] Sonia: A game changer during critical moments!

What’s New:
You can now link a passkey to your account, and view or manage it anytime under Account.

Bug Fixes:
Fixed an issue where the Alliance Star Party would disappear unexpectedly under special circumstances.
Starting [2026/11/1] (server time), the [Special Gold Brick Pack] will no longer be available in the [Gold Brick Store]. Equivalent packs on other platforms will also be removed at the same time.

Improvements:
Optimized [4th Squad]'s [Join Defense] status after activating the [Super Monthly Pass].
Fixed an issue where the Excavator name would display incorrectly under special circumstances.

Improvements:
Improved the Display of Special supplementary Tasks in Secret Mobile Squad by adding corresponding text labels.

Optimized the display of discount labels for purchasable packs and redeemable items in events.
Optimized the display interface of [Super Monthly Pass].

[Silver Brick] Optimizations:
- Added a confirmation pop-up when redeeming packs with Silver Bricks.
- The remaining quantity of Silver Bricks is now displayed on pack pages where packs can be redeemed with Silver Bricks.

[Alliance Star] Optimizations:
- Added [Lucky Scratch Card]. Scratch it to get surprise rewards!
- Winners of each award can claim [Alliance Celebration Fireworks] rewards.

Optimized mouse wheel scrolling speed in the PC chat interface, allowing you to browse chat messages more quickly.
Added an owner verification step when requesting character deletion. Once verified and deletion confirmed, the account data cannot be restored.

Added Reward Recovery for [Secret Mobile Squad] and [Truck]:
- When entering the Secret Task screen, if you had unstarted Secret Tasks from the previous day, you can claim some of the automatically recovered rewards via [Reward Recovery].

What’s New:
The [Status] feature is now available. You can set tags such as [In Combat], [Do Not Disturb], and [Taking a break] as your status via the [+] button in chat. Once set, the status will appear on [My Profile] and in private chats with other Commanders.

Improvements:
1. Removed the notification popup above Kimberly's model in the Initial Buy event at the Base.
2. The level cap for all bosses in the [Rampage Boss] event has been adjusted to [15].

Improvements:
[Trade Truck] Optimizations:
- You can now tap once to claim rewards from all completed [Trade Truck] when multiple trucks are ready at your base.
- Any unclaimed [Trade Truck] rewards will be sent to your system mail automatically after transferring.

Improvements:
New Items in Store:
[Alliance Store] now offers [50 Stamina] for 2,000 [Alliance Contribution]. Purchase limit: 5 per week.
[Honor Store] now offers [50 Stamina] for 1,000 [Honor Points]. Purchase limit: 50 per month.

Improvements:
1. Added the display of specific Zombie names and levels in battle reports for attacking wild Zombies.
2. When the first-kill rewards for Monsters such as Zombies and Doom Elites have not been obtained, other related rewards that cannot be earned from the current kill will no longer be shown on the Monster's preview screen.

Improvements:
1. The maximum number of players who can claim rewards from dig tasks (including Test Flight Failure) in Radar Tasks has been increased from 10 to 20.
2. The display of [Alliance Markers] has been improved — markers visible only to R4 & R5 will now have a special icon.

Improvements:
1. Unclaimed Daily Task rewards will be automatically sent via mail after the next server day refresh.
2. Event and battlefield resources can now be manually downloaded from the [Download Center].

Improvements:
1. Added a confirmation pop-up when deleting individual coordinates in the Favorite interface.
2. Added [Reinforcement] markers to battle reports generated by reinforcements.

Improvements:
1. Added acquisition methods for certain skins and items in the [Missing Items] interface.
2. Added a new feature to Alliance Notice that allows you to insert hyperlinks to News Center articles.

com.tencent.ig.n:
V4.7 is here! Explore the Arctic Chronicles themed mode and Erangel Subzero, plus a brand new PvE mode, WOW Brainrot snowy gameplay, and more! There have also been lots of improvements to the basic experience, and there's even a Bentley supercar collaboration—challenge the unknown!

Battle Royale
1. Themed Mode: Arctic Chronicles. The Ancient Beast has taken over the entire map, with interactive and explorable areas from head to tail. The beloved penguin ally PowNin has returned to fight alongside you!
2. Erangel Subzero: Erangel undergoes drastic weather changes in the face of a blizzard. Get ready for brand new tactics in a familiar place this December.
General Improvements
1. Event System Improvements: New Chicko's Loot activity redemption system to consolidate rewards and redeem in one place. New Activity Calendar to see all new weekly content at a glance.
2. Interface Improvements: The interfaces for X-Suit, Inventory, Workshop, Firearm, The Lab, and Popularity Battle have all been improved for a better experience.
Various Gameplay
1. New PvE Gameplay: The new and abandoned Seal City map is here. Experience the day-night cycle and watch PvE enemy behavior change accordingly. Loot, fight, extract—easier to pick up, with a faster pace.
2. WOW Brainrot: More fun and cute Brainrot content is on the way, with a snowy theme and innovative gameplay coming soon.

Update now and check out the battleground yourself.

The V4.6 Midnight Hunters vampire-themed mode is here! Hunters vs. Vampires—a classic battle between light and dark!

Battle Royale
1. Faction Showdown: Bloodline Awakening is a limited-time gameplay where defeated players can choose to return to the battleground as vampires and challenge the hunters.
2. New Items: Powerful items such as the Silvermoon Chain, Twilight Bat Wings, and Blood Pact are here, offering offense, defense, flight, and mobility.
3. Themed Environment: The four major urban areas have been occupied and transformed by the vampires. New mechanics such as the Hunters Guild, Clock Tower, and Scream Crates can be found across the entire map, with surprises everywhere.
4. PvE Challenge: New PvE enemies like the Bloodwalker and Vampire Elder are coming, with a new shield mechanic and finisher animations, plus great rewards waiting to be unlocked.

World of Wonder
Brainrot gameplay will be upgraded with a Halloweeks theme for a limited time. Stay tuned!

Meanwhile, the V3.3 Ocean Odyssey themed mode will return for a limited time in September. Team up with your friends to claim the trident and explore the mysteries of the deep sea!

V4.5 has two mega collaborations with NARUTO and Spider-Man: Brand New Day. Join the ultimate crossover battle now!

Battle Royale
NARUTO Collaboration
1. Themed Mode: The Nine-Tails has invaded! Join forces with all players to battle the rampaging Nine-Tails and protect the Hidden Leaf.
2. Classic Locations: Places like the Hidden Leaf Village and Valley of the End have been faithfully recreated to immerse you in the ninja world.
3. Seven Ninjutsu: Pull off ninja highlights with Flying Raijin Jutsu, Rasengan, and Chidori.
4. Free Perks: Play to get permanent character sets for Naruto and more! Tons of free rewards await!

Spider-Man: Brand New Day Collaboration
Available on July 30! Scale walls and swing like Spider-Man as you experience a new combat pace with aerial moves and agile attacks.

World of Wonder
Two major IP creation templates and themed maps are launching together! Freely create your own NARUTO and Spider-Man: Brand New Day gameplay maps, and unleash an endless crossover battleground of imagination!

The first ancient Greek myth-themed version, Hero's Crown is here! Conquer the four temple areas, complete five glorious trials, and recruit the centaur ally to fight alongside you!

Battle Royale
1. New Themed Mode: Four Mysterious Areas × Five New Trials → Challenge and recruit the centaur ally, and conquer the Crown's Abode.
2. Returning Themed Mode: Dinoground is back after three years!
3. Classic Mode: The 2-seater convertible Roadster is here with turbocharged speed.
New Collaborations
BLUE LOCK, Harley-Davidson, Ford, and more collaborations are coming soon! Stay tuned!
World of Wonder
Standalone Lobby (Swipe left to access) + Join matches in progress → Seamlessly find maps and team up.

The 8th Anniversary Version is now available! Are you ready for the new themed gameplay, new UI, new firearms and vehicles, and better perks?

Battle Royale
1. Themed Mode: The new character skill specialization system lets you create highlights based on your specialty, whether you're a sharpshooter, master medic, scouting sentinel, stealth hunter, or vehicle expert.
2. Classic Mode: New M1 Garand sniper rifle and upgraded Tracked Amphicarrier vehicle have been added.
New UI: Smoother and streamlined for a new sensory experience.
New Card Collection System: Get a free 3-level upgradable firearm on your first try! Multiple exclusvie card series are now available. Collect them all to unlock the gallery!
WOW: WOW 3rd Anniversary, upgraded incentive system, plus US $10 million prize pool available all year!

Rumor: Highly anticipated popular gameplay is said to be coming back, along with fun mini-games!The surprises don't stop there! A major collaboration featuring the popular anime Jujutsu Kaisen, renowned band OneRepublic, and top creator MrBeast is coming, kicking off the 8th Anniversary with a grand collaboration party! More excitement is coming to the battlegrounds!

8TH ANNIVERSARY FOR EVERY #1! No matter who you are or how you like to play, we hope you find your way of having fun in the 8th Anniversary's Evolving Universe!

PUBG MOBILE's new Primewood Genesis version officially launched on January 7! This version revolves around Erangel and the Sacred Tree, transforming five major urban areas to offer a strong sense of exploration and dynamic combat while retaining a familiar pace. The power of the Sacred Tree descends! Explore and purify a battleground intertwined with new structures and infected plants in this immersive ecological confrontation. Meanwhile, the highly anticipated Peaky Blinders collaboration launches on January 9. Stay tuned for more exciting content!

Classic Mode
1. Themed Items: New items include the Bramblewood Scorpion (a two-seater vehicle that can burrow underground and attack), Targeting Vines (provides strategic control and defense), Florawings (an equippable item that allows for varied movement), Cherry Blossom Deer (a two-seater vehicle that leaves a trail of flowers), and Overgrowth - Honey Badger (a weapon with two forms and healing capabilities).
2. Treant Ally: Barkle, the second smart ally after PowNin the penguin, is here! He is a dependable ally that offers combat support, shields, heals, carries, and searches for supplies.
3. Combat Improvement: More firearm balance and battle improvements, with a new cooperative climbing mechanic for smoother vertical combat.
4. Season System: New Promotion Match mechanic and Season Series system have both arrived. Enjoy upgraded honor rewards, plus improved competition and challenges.
Expanded Editor: The AI Assistant has been upgraded. Now you can automatically generate grouped objects through text descriptions, and create animations with a single tap by uploading reference videos, to make realizing your creativity even easier.
Metro Royale: New inheritable weapon, Glacix Arbiter. It features an iconic ice crystal butterfly knife appearance, is swift and deadly, and can defeat enemies in an instant!

PUBG MOBILE's Frosty Funland version was officially released on November 6! V4.1 features arctic towns inhabited by animals, tons of content and experience improvements, as well as a super cute ninja penguin ally to keep you company throughout. We sincerely invite you to team up with your friends and embark on a fantastical, icy adventure to explore the endless wonders of Frosty Funland! Also, the BABYMONSTER collaboration will be returning on 11/21, so stay tuned for more exciting content!
Stay tuned for more collaborations with Porsche and other well-known IPs to inject new energy into the battleground!
Classic Mode
1. Themed Items: Use the Penguin Snowmobile (amphibious four-seater vehicle, launches snowballs to deal damage, features co-op driving for faster speed), Salted Fish Rocket Launcher (Offers Control, Mobility, and Damage), Magic Ice Skates (creates special ice trails), Swordfish Syringe (heal yourself and your teammates), and Winterland Kar98K (charged shot triggers ice explosion) to fight and survive.
2. Interactions: The ninja penguin PowNin will be somewhere on the map. Interact and communicate with it in English. There are also other cute animal NPCs such as the Gunsmith Polar Bear, Apothecary Penguin, and Magic Fox. Interact with them to upgrade items or get surprise supply drops to aid your exploration.
3. Special Scenery: Go to Penguinville to compete for the core crate. Extra respawn chances will help you become the Strongest Team!
4. Combat Improvements: Enjoy firearm balance adjustments, better combat sound effects, and improved aiming for a completely upgraded combat experience!
WOW: New multiplayer racing map available! Pick your ride and race to the finish line for extreme speed and fun!
Metro Royale: Chapter 29 is here! Plus, Command Post and Fame system updates allow you to level up faster and get more rewards!

PUBG MOBILE's Spooky Soiree version arrives on September 4! V4.0 introduces tons of ghostly content, as well as new game modes and tons of collaborations! Get ready for the most spooktacular update of the year!

Classic Mode
1. Ghost Gameplay: Unlock shield, boost, flying, and healing abilities, plus you can engage in battles even after you get knocked out!
2. Mortar: A new weapon that deals high explosive damage. Supports both close aiming and ranged target selection, for more tactical versatility.
3. Weapon Adjustments: Stocks and foregrips have been completely revamped for more precise shooting feedback.
Asymmetric Game Mode: Unfail is now available! Experience the intense 1v4 pursuit and escape showdown between the Predator and the Survivors!
Metro Royale: Challenge your friends to a 1v1, check out the new limited seasonal crates, and face a new limited-time boss.
WOW: WOW 1.0 is officially here! Most players now have access to the editor and can win cash rewards!
Performance Update: The Super Smooth graphics option is now available, designed to improve the frame rate, reduce lag, minimize overheating, and lower power consumption!

PUBG MOBILE × Transformers is here!

Classic Mode:
1. Fated showdown between Optimus Prime and Megatron!
2. The 5.56mm ASM Abakan is here with three firing modes to meet all your tactical needs.
3. New sniper rifle barrel extender, as well as multiple attachment adjustments.
Metro Royale: Zombie Uprising 2.0 is here! Rise up to the challenge with the new exclusive Version 3.9 weapon, upgrades, and Fabled sellable items!
World of Wonder: Dive into new summer maps and cool off with an Ice Dragon boss battle!
Arena: Ranked Arena is available for a limited time with 4 maps. Climb the tiers for an exclusive Title reward!
Hub: The new 3D social lobby, Hub, is now available! Switch seamlessly from the existing Lobby to unwind in an immersive seaside town. Unlock a whole new social experience through exclusive interactive emotes and fun gameplay!

[Themed Mode Updates] Set Off On Your Steampunk Frontier Adventure
1. Themed Areas
1. Aetherholm: A large central train station with various recreational facilities for passengers. Players can summon a special train with cargo to arrive at the train platform, and there is an elevator that brings you to a secret room in the clock tower.
2. Cargo Hub: A cargo transit station consisting of two urban areas. Players can get around quickly via the tracks.
3. Hot Air Balloons: Aerial observation stations are situated along the railway or in the wilderness. Use them to ascend and glide from above.
2. Themed Items
1. ODM Gear: Can be obtained from crates, picked up from the ground, and purchased from shops. Equip it to fly around and perform slashing attacks.
2. Titan Serum: Use Titan Serum to transform into a Titan and gain high Health and mobility.
III. Gameplay
1. Giant Steam Trains: There is an Epoch Cargo Train and Express Train, each traveling along their designated routes. Climb aboard the trains to travel along with them. a) Express Train: A Mechanical Cache can be found in the driver's cabin, and the locomotive is connected to a lounge cabin and passenger cabin. b) Epoch Cargo Train: You can use a summoning item to call the Epoch Cargo Train in Aetherholm. After some time, the train will arrive and a mechanical grab will unload valuable supplies.
"2. Clockwork Attendant: Spend tokens to buy beverages from clockwork attendants on the trains and in Aetherholm. Drinks replenish your Health and Energy.
3. Clockwork Merchant: Purchase supplies from clockwork merchants at train platforms in Aetherholm and Cargo Hubs."

"1. Pillar UAZ: New Rondo vehicle with high durability.
2. Driver's Seat Firing: You can now fire one-handed firearms while driving the 2-Seat Motorcycle, Sidecar Motorcycle, Scooter, Bicycle, and 2-Seat Bike."
II. New Items
1. Spare Tire: Use it near a vehicle with a damaged tire to swap it out.
2. Portable Med Pack: Allows you to heal teammates using bandages, first aid kits, and med kits.
III. New Weapons
1. Sticky Bomb: A powerful explosive that sticks to any wall or vehicle surface.
2. Heavy Stock: An attachment that reduces firearm recoil, suitable for sustained fire.

[WOW Updates] More Creation Options, Updated Gameplay

3. Visual Programming: Added more blocks.
II. System Updates
1. New Challenge Gameplay: Play featured maps within a set time frame and aim to top the rankings for points.
2. Main Page Improvements
3. Improved Search
4. Data Center Improvements

I. Gameplay Updates
1. New Arctic Bas

Happy 7th Anniversary! This year, we're bringing you on a time traveling adventure:
Our first stop: the past! Some areas of Erangel and Livik have been restored to their original state from the early days of the game. Nothing beats the good old days; perhaps because we long for who we once were...
Our second stop: the present! You are the one who wields time in the new Golden Dynasty themed mode. Dominate battles on floating islands, get your hands on desert treasure, and make your team the strongest!
Our third stop: the future! What does a futuristic battleground look like? Explore Rondo, from the neon lights of Jadena City to the peaceful bamboo forests of Tin Long Garden. There's nothing Rondo doesn't have, and it's filled with amazing sights and awesome supplies sure to entice every adventurer.
We're so glad that everyone's been enjoying the different modes. Thank you for bearing witness to PUBG MOBILE's growth from a battle royale game to a full-fledged gaming platform! This is a whole new season of EA SPORTS FC™ Mobile! The 27 Season Update puts The World’s Game right in your hands! Shift the focus back to your club with game-changing tactical freedom, an intense squad-building challenge mode, and revolutionary PlayStyles designed to elevate your matchday experience.

 NEW 27 FEATURES

GAME PLANS & DYNAMIC TACTICS
 Take full control of your team's tactical identity with the new Game Plan system.
 -In-Match Switching: Adapt on the fly by changing formations and mentalities dynamically mid-match.
 -5 Mentality Tiers: Fine-tune your strategy across Ultra Defensive, Defensive, Balanced, Attacking, and Ultra Attacking.
 -Custom Presets: Create and save up to 4 distinct Game Plans to switch between instantly during matches.

GAUNTLET MODE
 Take on the FC Mobile Gauntlet through a series of challenging rounds that test your squad depth and tactical skills.
 - Each round features unique Match Objectives, Traits, and House Rules.
 - House Rules such as Hot Zone, Position Hero, and No Rules can also change how each match plays.
 - Strategic Squad Management: Player Items have limited appearances per run, forcing you to rotate your roster.
 -Progress through nodes, earn Stars, and unlock milestone Rewards.

GAMEPLAY UPDATES
 Two new PlayStyles bring player abilities to life:
 - Incisive Through Pass: Thread through-balls with improved target selection and greater lead distance.
 - Dead Ball: Bend free kicks with increased curl, pace, dip, and precision.

AUDIO & VISUALS
 - Localized Matchday Energy: Feel the passion of the crowd with updated, immersive localized commentary in Mexican Spanish, Indonesian, and Thai.
 - Signature Celebrations: Express your victories in style with brand-new iconic goal celebrations, including "Predator", "Flex", "Fist Pump", "Rockstar", and "Tuxedo"!
 - Enjoy an overall visual refresh of the game in this new season update.

Play The World’s Game, anywhere.

Play The World’s Game update. Compete in a global soccer tournament and lead your national team to glory. Experience authentic player attributes with Playstyles that bring athletes' unique abilities to life.  Instantly connect with friends & play PVP in Quick Match. FC Mobile now supports Hindi, Czech & Polish The World’s Game Update also features a brand new nostalgia-themed soundtrack.

THE WORLD’S GAME TOURNAMENT
Compete vs the world in The World’s Game international soccer tournament. Choose from over 50 national teams, including Brazil, Portugal, England, USA and help them lift the cup. Play through tournament brackets or customize your matches & earn rewards based on difficulty and performance. The journey is more cinematic than ever with new opening videos, and soundtrack and broadcast packages.

PLAYSTYLES
Go beyond attributes with PlayStyles. This feature brings unique athlete abilities to life, making players feel more realistic. PlayStyles icons now appear on 3D player items and update in real-time during matches and set pieces. You can also see which PlayStyles were activated during post-goal showcases. From Finesse Expert curves to Bruiser physicality, feel the tangible impact of signature traits on every play.

QUICK MATCH
Create a Quick Match lobby and & invite a friend or share direct links to social media for fast, seamless setups. You can also add up to 100 friends to play with! Hosts have full control over the lobby, including setting Extra Time or Penalty Shootout modes. Compete using your Ultimate Team or select from iconic National Teams & Clubs. The Rematch feature lets you jump right back into the action with the same settings.

GAMEPLAY & VISUALS
Enjoy balanced gameplay with improved close-range finishing and optimized auto-tackling and national team-specific commentary. Plus, perform new signature celebrations for stars like Cristiano Ronaldo, Kylian Mbappé, and Lionel Messi.

LANGUAGES & AUDIO
FC Mobile now supports Hindi, Czech & Polish (including Polish Commentary). The World’s Game Update also features a brand new nostalgia-themed soundtrack!
Celebrate the World’s Game & lift the cup with over 50+ National Teams in EA SPORTS FC™ Soccer Mobile.

BUG FIXES
We've addressed some issues with sprint dribble acceleration in gameplay and fixed the button visuals for Through passes.

Achievements are now part of your FC Mobile journey!
Play matches, score goals, train players, and climb the ranks to unlock achievements that celebrate your biggest milestones. Each one marks a key step in your soccer career — and you can proudly showcase them in Apple’s Games app or Game Center.

Here’s what’s new:
1. Unlock achievements across multiple gameplay activities:
- Division Rivals Matches
- Goals
- Leaderboard Rank Ups
- Player Training & Rank Ups
- Total Matches Played
- League Friendlies

2. Unlock and Showcase Achievements
Celebrate your biggest soccer moments and show them off to friends through Apple’s Games app or Game Center.
- FC Rookie: Complete 1 match
- Emerging Talent: Complete 2 Division Rivals matches
- Elite Contender: Complete 50 Division Rivals matches
- Matchday Warrior: Complete 100 Division Rivals matches
- Budding Star: Score 10 goals
- Seasoned Striker: Score 50 goals
- GOAT: Score 100 goals
- World Class: Reach World Class
- Legendary Player: Reach Legendary
- FC Champion: Reach FC Champion
- Shaping Potential: Complete 5 Rank Ups
- Forging Champions: Complete 30 Rank Ups
- Getting Stronger: Level up a Player Item to Training Level 10
- Peak Performance: Level up a Player Item to Training Level 30
- Friendlies: Play 5 Friendly Matches against members of your League

How to View Your Achievements
If you’re on iOS 26 or later, open the new Games app, tap your profile picture, and select EA SPORTS FC™ Mobile under Achievements to see your progress.
If you’re using an earlier iOS version, open the App Store, tap your profile icon (top-right), tap Game Center (with your nickname), then tap Achievements and select EA SPORTS FC™ Mobile to view your progress.

EA SPORTS FC™ MOBILE 26 Update - The Club Is Yours
The FC Mobile 26 Update brings a fresh new look and major feature upgrades across visuals, gameplay, and personalization, inspired by the fans. From an updated Matchmaking Lobby to updated player face likenesses and tactical formations, this update delivers an even more authentic and rewarding soccer experience.

REVAMPED MATCHMAKING LOBBY
In the newly updated PVP match lobby, both your captain and your opponent's captain stand face-to-face, showcasing new vanity items and bringing more immersive head-to-head competition to the game.

TEAM BADGE SYSTEM
Collect and equip Team Badges to earn powerful attribute boosts for your team. Strategically fill badge slots in your lineup, track your collection progress, and earn extra season rewards by completing badge sets or player collections.

UPDATED PLAYER FACE LIKENESSES & MEMORABLE GOALS
Over 100+ updated face likenesses of star players bring them to life. Plus, celebrate in style with new post-goal celebrations.

NEW FORMATIONS
Test out new tactical setups, including the highly requested 4-2-1-3 and 4-1-3-2, giving you more flexibility in both PvP and PvE matches.

NEW COMMENTARY & AUDIO
New Turkish and Polish commentary. Updated sound effects and event music bring more energy to every match.

GAMEPLAY REFINEMENTS
Experience more balanced and dynamic gameplay with smarter Referee foul detection, reduced Kickoff Rush effectiveness, improved passing accuracy, and faster, more agile dribbling. Accuracy tied more closely to attributes & driven ground passes are easier to control.

OTHER UPDATES
Discover new tools and features beyond the pitch, including Player Compare, which lets you line up player items side-by-side to review both basic and advanced stats. Security improvements behind the scenes help us combat cheating and ensure fair-play. Plus, enjoy smoother FCMTV streaming in Extra Time and progressive rewards the longer you watch for select live broadcasts.

Enjoy even more licensed soccer content from the new 25/26 season of soccer, including 19,000+ players from 690 teams across 35 leagues. Update now to enjoy upgraded features, new ways to play, and more reasons to celebrate.

Inspired by & created for the fans. The Club Is Yours!

EA SPORTS FC™ Mobile’s Rivals Update is here!
Bring your Ultimate Team to glory with a complete overhaul of Division Rivals. Climb up the ranks in EA SPORTS FC Mobile's PVP modes with a new star-based rank system, redesigned interface, and rewards.
Step into the redesigned Locker Room and select your favourite kits, stadiums, logos, emotes, and name boards to flex your style on the biggest stage.
On the pitch, gameplay has been enhanced with more responsive ground passing and VS Attack rebalancing.

Division Rivals Overhaul
Redesigned Interface
-Division Rivals features a streamlined layout to help you track progress, see rewards, and manage your lineups.
-New pre-match hub that highlights your key Player and Division progress.
-Track your performance with a new season recap.

New Star-Based Rank System
-Collect Stars to climb up the Divisions and become an FC Champion.
-Star Shields help safeguard your position from relegation after tough losses.
-Earn new Division promotion rewards as you climb the ranks.

Weekly Leaderboards & Rewards
-Compete in weekly Leaderboards to earn rewards based on your performance.
-Win daily matches to earn extra rewards throughout the week.

Upgraded Locker Room
-Easily select your kit, logo, stadium, emotes, and name board to flex your style.
-Show off on the leaderboards with the new name board.
-Choose different kits for Home and Away Matches.

Gameplay Updates
Passing & Build-Up Play
-Ground Passes now better align with your aim and teammate movement, momentum, and positioning.
-Ground Through Passes lead more effectively when space is available and are less likely to overshoot along the sidelines.
-Driven Ground Passes are now more accurate and better avoid defenders based on context.

VS Attack Improvements
-Basic, Good, and Great Chances have been reworked to better reflect difficulty and quality.
-Chances end faster after saves, tackles, long fouls, or missed crosses to get you back into the action.
-New camera settings available.

More Fixes & Improvements
-Heel to Heel and Stepover & Exit now scale with player attributes, reducing speed bursts.
-Defenders with better height and jumping stats are now prioritized in central areas on corner kicks.
-Fixed an issue where the camera would remain stuck after a blocked free kick.

From showing off your style in the revamped Locker Room to rising up the ranks in the new Division Rivals, the Rivals Update is sure to bring competition to the next level! Take control of the pitch with improved passing and build-up play, and progress up the leaderboards for top rewards! Compete Head to Head and earn rewards for your squad in the Rivals Update in EA SPORTS FC™ Mobile!
From the match preparation to the final whistle, the Rivals Update brings a deeper, authentic,  and more competitive soccer experience.

Step into the redesigned Locker Room and select your favourite kits, stadiums, logos, emotes, and name boards to flex your style on the biggest stage.
On the pitch, gameplay has been enhanced with more responsive ground passing and VS Attack rebalancing.

Division Rivals Overhaul
Redesigned Interface
-Division Rivals features a streamlined layout to help you track progress, see rewards, and manage your lineups.
-New pre-match hub that highlights your key Player and Division progress.
-Track your performance with a new season recap.

New Star-Based Rank System
-Collect Stars to climb up the Divisions and become an FC Champion.
-Star Shields help safeguard your position from relegation after tough losses.
-Earn new Division promotion rewards as you climb the ranks.

Weekly Leaderboards & Rewards
-Compete in weekly Leaderboards to earn rewards based on your performance.
-Win daily matches to earn extra rewards throughout the week.

Upgraded Locker Room
-Easily select your kit, logo, stadium, emotes, and name board to flex your style.
-Show off on the leaderboards with the new name board.
-Choose different kits for Home and Away Matches.

Gameplay Updates
Passing & Build-Up Play
-Ground Passes now better align with your aim and teammate movement, momentum, and positioning.
-Ground Through Passes lead more effectively when space is available and are less likely to overshoot along the sidelines.
-Driven Ground Passes are now more accurate and better avoid defenders based on context.

VS Attack Improvements
-Basic, Good, and Great Chances have been reworked to better reflect difficulty and quality.
-Chances end faster after saves, tackles, long fouls, or missed crosses to get you back into the action.
-New camera settings available.

More Fixes & Improvements
-Heel to Heel and Stepover & Exit now scale with player attributes, reducing speed bursts.
-Defenders with better height and jumping stats are now prioritized in central areas on corner kicks.
-Fixed an issue where the camera would remain stuck after a blocked free kick.

From showing off your style in the revamped Locker Room to rising up the ranks in the new Division Rivals, the Rivals Update is sure to bring competition to the next level! Take control of the pitch with improved passing and build-up play, and progress up the leaderboards for top rewards! Compete Head to Head and earn rewards for your squad in the Rivals Update in EA SPORTS FC™ Mobile!
From the match preparation to the final whistle, the Rivals Update brings a deeper, authentic,  and more competitive soccer experience.

EA SPORTS FC™ Mobile’s League Update is here! Featuring expanded Leagues and gameplay improvements to elevate your game experience.
Leagues now support up to 100 members. Complete Seasonal Quests, climb the Leaderboards and earn rewards through League vs. League Tournaments. The refined passing, defending, and fluid gameplay make each match more engaging. Try them out now!

League Update
- Expanded Capacity: Updated Leagues now support up to 100 members, fostering better community interaction and teamwork.
- Collaborative Quests: Team up with League members in season-long Quests to earn rewards and increase your League’s rank on the Leaderboards.
- Seasonal Rewards: Earn rewards and Bonuses based on your League contributions. These rewards recognize both individual effort and League-wide achievements that underscore your League’s power and skill level.
- Leaderboards and Tournaments: Compete in tournaments to climb Global and Group Leaderboards, showcasing your League’s prowess and signifying your League’s standing.
- League Achievements: Boost your league's prestige with fresh achievements that highlight your team's collective feats. These accolades are perfect for bragging about your league's commitment and success across various challenges.
- Enhanced Management Tools: Simplify League management with new tools for handling memberships and settings.

Gameplay Enhancements
- Pass Mastery: Ground and Through Passes are now more accurate, giving you better control in tight situations and during open play.
- Dynamic Defending: Defence has been upgraded to reward skill, accuracy, and timing. Successful Stand Tackles will now cause the Opponent Dribbler to stumble or even fall, greatly increasing your chances of retrieving the ball.
- AI and Movement Improvements: Encounter smarter opposition with updated AI that scales to provide a more challenging experience.
- Improved End of Half Decision: Gameplay now continues more seamlessly around half-time, preventing abrupt stops and ensuring a fair end to each half.
- H2H Balancing: Skill moves like Heel to Heel and Open Fake Shot have been adjusted to create a fairer balance between dribblers and defenders. The Skill Move Stun effect has been removed entirely.

Visual Improvements
- New Weather added: Enjoy more realistic matches with the introduction of snow weather conditions.
- Visual Improvements: The enhanced visual effects include brighter highlights on jerseys and shoes and a more pronounced depth of field during player introductions and goal celebrations.
- Lineup Management: Players eligible for upgrades are now marked with clearer indicators for easy management.
- Increased Frame Rates: Higher-end devices can enjoy smoother, visually stunning gameplay with increased frame rates and enhanced graphic quality

Bug Fixes
- Club Challenge Icons: Corrected a misrepresentation by swapping the icons for Top Scorer and Most Assists in the Club Challenge winner screen.
- Club Challenge Winning Page: Fixed

FIFA Mobile has now been FC Mobile for an entire year! Join us in celebrating EA SPORTS FC™ Mobile’s 1st Anniversary Update! Discover even more authentic mobile soccer gaming in new features like the Football Centre and take on the Club Challenge with top leagues like LALIGA EA SPORTS and the Premier League. Enjoy improved gameplay updates including smoother passing, responsive dribbling, and smarter AI for more engaging matches.

What’s Included in This Update:

New Features:
- Football Centre: Connects players directly to the pulse of real-world soccer, allowing engagement with events and features that mirror the current soccer season.
- Club Challenge: Play as any team from LALIGA EA SPORTS and the Premier League in real-time, competitive matches through a structured PvP tournament.

More Players, More Clubs, More Leagues:
- New Icon Cover Star: Jude Bellingham from Real Madrid!
- FC Mobile has the biggest competitions, leagues, & players across the world now with more than 18K fully licensed players, 690+ teams, & 30+ football leagues.
- New Players: New prodigies like Endrick & legendary ICONs like Gianluigi Buffon & Gareth Bale.

Gameplay Enhancements:
- Enhanced Gameplay Mechanics: Smoother passing, more responsive dribbling, and smarter AI elevate the challenge and immersion of each match.

User Experience Improvements:
- Change your Name: Players can now change their in-game usernames for the first time ever!
- Added new filter conditions in TRAINING, EXCHANGE, and TRANSFER MARKET to show tradable players.

Other Bug Fixes:
- Fixed the issue with usability in Player Inventory, ensuring the interface remains on the recently selected player.
- Resolved an issue where moving between campaign chapters redirected players to the first chapter
- Addressed stability issues across various types of devices, enhancing performance and minimizing crashes.

As we step into a new season, celebrate FC Mobile’s first Anniversary with a special event that highlights the new season of club soccer/football, newly transferred Players and prodigious young stars. Get ready for the beginning of the new FC Mobile chapter. Anywhere For the Club.

As UEFA EURO 2024™ wraps up, this update focuses on resolving key live issues to enhance your gameplay experience. With these improvements, exciting new events await your exploration. As always, stay tuned in to our EA SPORTS FC™ Mobile (formerly FIFA Mobile) social channels for additional live updates!

We’ve made improvements and fixes in the following areas:

Training Transfer:
Attribute Display Fixed: Corrected display errors on the Training Transfer Success screen to ensure attributes are shown accurately.
Transfer Eligibility Fix: Fixed a bug where the source player card with 0 Training Level remained selectable for transfer, despite having no Training Level to transfer.
Experience Overflow Fix: Corrected a bug where the XP of the source player card incorrectly increased due to overflow from a fully trained target player card.
Animation Restoration: Fixed an issue where the animation for a successful training transfer was missing.

Key Match:
Home and Away Team Display Fix: Corrected an issue where home and away team names were reversed at the end of matches when playing as the away team.
Difficulty Display Fix: Corrected a display error where, when forfeiting a match at any difficulty level other than "Amateur," the difficulty was incorrectly shown as "Amateur."

Exchange Interface:
Currency Display Fix: Corrected a visual glitch where the Currency bar disappeared when navigating back from player details within the Exchange interface.

See you on the pitch!

com.s01.global.n:
[New Content]
1. Secured Alliance Gathering Node:
A new feature that provides a safe resource gathering location for alliance members.
- Unlock Condition: Available once the Empire reaches a certain progression point.
- Gathering Rules: After placement, alliance members can gather resources without being attacked. Each member can only send one squad to gather.
2. Lord Gear and Lord Charm Material Exchange:
- Lords can exchange excess materials in the Gear interface for Gear and Charm-related items. Make good use of resources and boost your power! (Becomes available when empires reach a certain progress).

[Optimizations and Adjustments]
1. Eternity's Reach Optimizations:
(1) Improved ranking rewards with new Oasis Island buildings
(2) Improved prompts for using Sanctuary Skills for clearer controls
(3) Added an option to switch the displayed sign-up time for easier viewing
(4) Adjusted the number of players on the battlefield for fairer competition
2. Hero Adjustment:
Fixed an issue where "Hera"'s Expedition Skill, "Sundering Wound", would not take effect in certain situations.
3. Resource Gathering Screen Optimization:
- Added a display for Gathering Bonus effects and a quick-access button to the City Bonuses - "Growth" tab for effortless viewing and usage of Gathering Speed items.
4. Rally Optimization:
- Added a new Starred feature to Rallies. By starring a Lord's Rally, all future Rallies launched by them will be listed first in Alliance Wars.
5. World Map Optimization:
- New Entry: World map now has a "Wilderness" quick-access entry for wilderness towns.
6. Arena Optimization:
- New Prompts: Formation interface now includes hero upgrade prompts and quick-access buttons for convenient progression.
7. Castle Battle Optimizations:
- Directional Indicators: Turret names now include directional markers (North, South, East, West) for easier location.
8. Teleport Feature Optimizations:
(1) [Territory Teleporter] now supports free dragging, allowing Lords to choose their destination before confirming the teleport.
(2) Wilderness Teleport: When teleporting in the wilderness, if the target location is within your alliance's territory, the Territory Teleport feature will be prioritized.
9. Added a Sort by Hero Type feature to show the heroes in a different order.
10. Added Daily Missions for Realm Trial.
11. Mission Progress Bar Optimizations:
Optimized mission progress bars for events such as Alliance Mobilization and Hall of Lords, making progress clear at a glance.
12. Art and Visual Optimizations:
(1) Improved the visuals of some beasts and environments on the world map.
(2) Improved the visuals of some Oasis Island buildings.

[New Content]
1. New Feature [Oasis Island]: The sailors are ready and awaiting your command! Set sail in search of the legendary Oasis Island and build a new home.
2. New Feature [Realm Trial]: Take on challenges across six themed zones: the Radiant Spire, Molten Fort, Knowledge Nexus, Coliseum, Crystal Cave, and Forest of Life. Clear stages to earn generous rewards.
3. Comprehensive Skin System Upgrade:
(1) Added new skin categories for [Name Card], [Chat], [Rally], [Teleport], and [Profile], offering even more ways to express yourself.
(2) Added the [Throne Bastion] Castle Skin and [Dueler] March Skin.
(3) Added multiple new skins, including the [Empire Radiance] and [Guardian Army] Avatar Frames, the [Empire Radiance] and [Guardian Army] Nameplates, and the [Gem Shower] and [Cool] Emotes.
4. Added the [Lord Profile - Mood] feature: Set your Mood Status to let other Lords know how you feel and make interactions more fun.
5. Added the [Alliance Bomb] feature: Alliance officers can deploy bombs within their Alliance territory to clear Resource Nodes not being gathered by any Lord, as well as Beasts and Terrors, making Teleporting more convenient.
6. Added [Alliance Mobilization Mission Vouchers]: Use them to quickly refresh missions during Alliance Mobilization and select the mission type.
7. Added the [Empire Waystation]: Eligible Lords can unlock the [Empire Waystation] in the Top-up Center and purchase Empire Star Packs. Some packs also include bonus gifts to empower your journey across the Empire.
8. Added the [Empire Radiance Gift] event: Reward tiers are determined by each Lord's highest Top-up Points from a single payment. Once your highest Top-up Points from a single payment meet the specified requirement, you can claim rewards including the animated [Cool] Emote, permanent [Empire Radiance Name Card] Skin, permanent [Empire Radiance] Chat Skin, abundant resources, and Empire Stars.
Reminder: If your historical highest Top-up Points from a single payment already meet the corresponding requirement, you can claim the relevant rewards as soon as the event begins.
9. Added the [Empire Supreme Gift] event: Reward tiers are determined by each Lord's total Top-up Points accumulated in a single day. Accumulate the required Top-up Points on any day between 00:00:00 and 23:59:59 UTC to claim rewards including the permanent [Empire's Call] Teleport Skin.
Reminder: If your historical total Top-up Points on any single day already meet the corresponding requirement, you can claim the relevant rewards as soon as the event begins.

[Optimizations and Adjustments]
1. Pack Adjustment: "Fast Development Pack" has become unavailable after this update and can no longer be purchased when removed. A brand-new pack has been released at the same time, please check it out.
2. Several new reward tiers will be added to the "Top-up Gift" event. Complete them to obtain permanent skins: "Empire Radiance Avatar Frame" and "Empire Radiance Nameplate", along with many ra

[Optimizations & Adjustments]
1. Alliance Optimizations:
(1) Added Alliance Whitelist. Whitelisted lords can skip the application approval process and join the Alliance quickly. Alliances that have whitelisted you will also appear first in the Alliance list, helping you quickly return to a familiar team.
(2) Alliance Notices now support likes and dislikes, allowing members to give instant feedback.
(3) Added Alliance Rules to help allies get up to speed quickly.

2. Bear Hunt:
Added Personal Damage Achievement rewards. After the update, lords who participate in Bear Hunt can earn the new Total Historical Personal Damage Achievement rewards for even greater gains.
*The above adjustments will take effect after the update. Damage dealt to "Raging Bear" before the update will not be counted, so please plan your game time accordingly.

3. Prestige Benefits:
(1) Players on servers that have been open for 15 days and have reached VIP Lv. 12 can access Prestige Benefits from the VIP screen.
Benefits include Prestige Spinner and Prestige Shop. Spend Top-up Points to draw Prestige Badges, which can be exchanged for limited rewards.
(2) Added the City Skin [Eternal Throne], March Skin [Hurricane of Destruction], Avatar Frame [Heart of Eternity Avatar Frame], and Nameplate [Heart of Eternity]. All can be obtained through Prestige Benefits.

4. Formation Feature Optimizations:
(1) Added Formation name settings. You can customize Formation names using up to 3 letters or numbers for clearer management.
(2) Increased the current formation cap by adding 2 formation slots, unlocked when the Town Center reaches Lv. 26 and Lv. 30 respectively.
(3) Once your Town Center reaches Lv. 19, the Formation screen will support saving presets by soldier quantity or soldier type ratio.

5. Gesture Control Optimizations:
Added the Swipe Back feature, which can be enabled in Settings. Swipe left or right from the edge of the screen to quickly switch pages.

6. Desert Trial:
During the event, Dreadwolves can now be quickly found and attacked from the Wilderness Search screen, making it easier to join in.

7. Visual Optimization:
Optimized the appearance of the [Burst of Life] City Skin.

[Bug Fixes]
1. Auto Hunting Optimizations:
Fixed an issue where [Lord Stamina] was not automatically refunded after a battle was terminated under rare circumstances.

[Optimizations and Adjustments]
1. Gathering Carriage Visual Optimization: The appearance of the carriage has been optimized to better match the game's overall style.
2. March Visual Optimization: Fixed an issue where the [Prismatic Aide] March Skin had no ground shadow.
3. Screen Adaptation: Added a non-standard screen edge spacing adaptation feature to setting.
4. Chat Emote Optimization: Applied style optimizations to some of the King's emote.
5. City Weather Optimization: Reduced the frequency of full cloudy day on the city map.
The throne awaits its rightful ruler.

com.project.idle.cd.n:
【New Features and Improvements】
1. Added an extra confirmation prompt when starting "Joint Exercise".
2. After cross-server raiding unlocks, a prompt warns when raiding a Covert Mission on your own server.
3. Added local/server time switching for some events; scheduling automatically shows local time based on the selected server time.
4. Increased the Presidential Mail character limit.

【New and Optimizations】
1. Added automatic approval for "President Item" authorization requests. When the President enables auto-approval, requests on the list will be approved in order.
2. Optimized the in-game local time display to accommodate seasonal time changes.
3. Optimized the loot claim limit in "Nuclear Reckoning" and added the option to share loot in chat channels.

1. New Sunday event: Battlefield Assault.

6. Auto-challenge the next Main Campaign stage after clearing Stage 550.

【Optimizations】
1. Expanded the Total Hero Power ranking eligibility for the Intermediate Commander Arena to the top 1,000 players.
2. Reduced the number of Red Grunts required for the Daily Task “Defeat Red Grunts” to 2.
3. Added a Raging Bay event time reminder to the To-Do List.
4. Reduced the difficulty of some City Recon event stages in Radar Tasks.

【New】
1. Added Alliance Image Sharing
2. Added Alliance Star
3. Added the large-scale cross-server battlefield event Star Core Collection War
4. Added game languages: Polish, Turkish, Russian, Italian, and Japanese
5. Added new animation displays for Daisy and Brock

io.supercent.bulldozermasters.n:
New Event Mode 'Lost Mine' Added
- By combining random support cards and skills during the mining process, you can enjoy the bulldozer in a new way every time.
- Collect gems in the mine to achieve weekly goals and earn special rewards such as an exclusive Secretary and Secretary fragments.

Secretary Affinity & Skin System
- You can increase Affinity by gifting items obtained from stages. As Affinity increases, stat buffs and Gem rewards are provided, and you can obtain an exclusive skin upon reaching the max level.
New Products Added
- Piggy Bank: Mileage is automatically accumulated based on Gem consumption, and you can purchase Gems when a certain amount is reached.
- 1 of 3 Choice Package: You can choose and purchase 1 desired reward package out of 3 options.
- 3-Day Attendance Package: Provides attendance rewards upon logging in for 3 cumulative days after purchase.

New Ores/Secretaries/Equipment Added
- Mystery Ore: 2 types of special ores, including one that increases Secretary Affinity when destroyed, have been added.
- New Lineup: 3 new Secretaries including Scarlet and Sandy, along with 2 new Light Equipment and 2 Heavy Equipment have been added.

1. New Content
- Secretary Office: Added to the left side of the office. Assign acquired Secretary characters as Leaders or Members to gain team buffs such as Stage Clear Bonuses and reduced Worker Hiring Costs. Appointing and leveling up Secretaries requires Biz Points and Character Fragments.
- Overseas Business Division: Added to the right side of the office, allowing access to global LiveOps event hubs.
- New Onboarding: Step-by-step guides have been added for key features, including the World Map, LiveOps Events, Dynamite, and the Secretary "Sophia."

2. Emergency Mining Contract Event
- A limited-time special event stage that rotates through specific areas on the World Map has been added.
- Special Heavy Equipment & Rules: Regular equipment usage is restricted. Depending on the event area, exclusive heavy equipment such as the Drill Crusher or Roller Crusher will be provided.
- Various Stage Conditions: In addition to fixed buffs such as 3x Light Equipment Cargo Capacity and 3x Truck Speed, random conditions (additional Workers, increased Stamina, expanded Absorption Range, etc.) are applied at the start of each stage, requiring strategic gameplay.
- Event-exclusive Progression & Rewards: Use Event Bonds earned during the event to upgrade equipment. Various special rewards are granted for clearing stages and overcoming hurdles.

- Special Heavy Equipment & Rules: Regular equipment usage is restricted. Depending on the event area, exclusive heavy equipment such as the Drill Crusher or Roller Crusher will be provided.
- Various Stage Conditions: In addition to fixed buffs such as 3x Light Equipment Cargo Capacity and 3x Truck Speed, random conditions (additional Workers, increased Stamina, expanded Absorption Range, etc.) are applied at the start of each stage, requiring strategic gameplay.
- Event-exclusive Progression & Rewards: Use Event Bonds earned during the event to upgrade equipment. Various special rewards are granted for clearing stages and overcoming hurdles.

Shop Opening & Special Package Launch
-Visit the Shop to get free Gems.
-The Founder’s Pack is now available, featuring the heavy-duty “Impact Hauler,” which lets you mine and gather at the same time.

Worker System Revamp
-A new system has been added that allows you to review workers’ resumes and hire them directly.
-A Stamina system for managing worker activity and a Worker Lounge that provides boost benefits have been added.
-You can equip workers with light equipment to further improve their work efficiency.
-An HR Department for improving workers’ stats and 5 new worker appearances have been added.

Progression Support & Quality-of-Life Improvements
-Learn the game more easily and earn rewards through Guide Quests.
-When you spend Cash, you will receive a special cashback bonus.

New R&D and Sales Departments are open!
Walkways & Auto Miners added to boost mining fun and logistics!
Two new trucks added, appearing based on load capacity!
Bug fixes & stability improvements for smoother gameplay!
