NEW CHAMPIONS
Star-Lord (Kitty Pryde)
Peter was forced to abandon his role as team leader and Kitty now takes on cosmic threats as Star-Lord.

Beast (Rework)
A beastly name and body hold the mind of an expert on mutations and evolutionary human biology.

Victorious Four
A cosmic accident transformed them into beings of destructive power. The guidance of Victor Von Doom allowed them to reclaim control. Named the Victorious Four in honor of Victor, this quartet defends Latveria in humble gratitude.

NEW CHAMPIONS

Spider-Man Noir
On Earth-90214, in 1930s New York, Peter B. Parker is the nephew of the activist Aunt May with a strong hatred for crime, particularly towards those who killed his Uncle Ben. When following a criminal tip led to an accident, he gained arachnid-like abilities when bit by a spider. Publicly he’s a Private Investigator, but secretly he uses his powers to take down crime as the hardboiled Spider-Man Noir.

Gwenom
While Gwen Stacy faced the mutated Venom Symbiote of Earth-65, the Kingpin known as Matt Murdock revealed that her father had been beaten into a coma by Rhino with little to no chance of survival. Fueled by rage, Gwen gave into the rhythms of her heart and let the symbiote take over, granting her immense destructive power and turning her into the most unstable, broken version of herself: Gwenom.

Green Goblin (Stellar-Forged)

So now Green Goblin takes to the skies with sinister science at his command!

M’Baku
The charismatic and formidable leader of the Jabari Tribe, is one of Wakanda’s most powerful warriors and a frequent rival of T’Challa. Blue Marvel
Adam Brashear had always been a prodigy—a college football star with multiple Ph.D.s who earned two Silver Stars serving as a Marine in the Korean War. While leading Project: Perseus, an attempt to harness the power of antimatter, Adam and his fellow Marine Conner Sims were caught in a reactor explosion. Conner was vaporized, but the reaction stabilized within Adam’s body, granting him the amazing powers of the Blue Marvel. When his identity as a Black man was revealed in a titanic battle alongside the Avengers, Adam was asked by the President to retire, as the country was not ready for the most powerful man in America to be openly and unapologetically Black. For decades, he obliged, but after losing much of his family in another accident, he has since returned to stand against the ever present threats of the modern world.

Lumatrix:
At first glance Lumatrix appears to be a charming entertainer who dazzles others with an array of impressive light manipulation powers, but underneath their smile lurks a menace that hungers for violence. Lumatrix's role is not that of an entertainer, but an assassin designed by The Founders to infiltrate, sabotage, and eliminate their targets. It may have been more pragmatic to craft an Eidol with a less flashy aesthetic, but The Founders sought to keep one of their deadliest weapons in plain sight. Balancing shining brilliance with dark intent, brings forth one of the most dangerous Eidols to ever walk The Battlerealm.

NEW QUESTS AND EVENTS

Story Quest - Act 9 Chapter 2 - INQUISITION
The epic story of The Contest continues! Carina has been tragically wounded following an encounter with the Ouroborus forces. It now falls to an unlikely pairing of The Fantastic Four and Doctor Doom to search The Battlerealm for answers, assistance, and allies. As Chronoserpent corruption is found in every corner of The Contest, it seems even the most mighty and worthy have fallen to temptation. Not even the Gods of this multiverse are spared as the new villain LOTAN looks to show their foes that now is the time strike.

Event Quest - Spy Games
Black Widow has been researching the arrival of the Eidols and needs a trusted friend to continue this spy-craft. Luckily Jessica Drew, AKA Spider-Woman, is ready to swing into action! Will these super spies be able to see through the sinister light-show of the newest Eidol arrival? Or will they be actors in a twisted play?

Side Quest - Dark Bounties
With ruin burning in her wake, Dark Phoenix has placed a bounty on a number of unfortunate Champions. Unlock Dark Bounties and hunt them down then seize your rewards. Be warned, some have slipped away in the chaos, evading your grasp while others stand to face you. Take care of those who dare to challenge you now and hunt the remaining ones down later. Sift through the ashes and claim the bounty rewards.

Incursions: Dark Phoenix Saga Sector
The Incursions Saga Sector Returns with Dark Phoenix! Gather your strongest Saga champions and fight to earn Dark Plumes ,Light Essence, Tier 7 Basic Fragments, 7-Star Class Signature Stones and more! Additionally, the Top Zone Reward cadence will be changed from 5 days to 7 days, giving you more time to push further in your Incursions runs.

Alliance War Showcase - Deathless
The Alliance War Show

NEW CHAMPIONS

Jean Grey:
The last member of Professor Charles Xavier's first class of X-Men, and former host to the cosmic entity known as the Phoenix Force, Jean Grey is one of the most powerful mutants the world has ever known. A blessing for us all, then, that her many experiences with death and renewed life have shaped her into a hero who is concerned not with the self but with the collective on a grand scale.

Bastion:
Forged as the ultimate mutant eliminating Sentinel, Sebastion "Bastion" Gilberti is a Sentinel born human, destined to bring the future to the present day.  With his prime Sentinels at his side, Bastion will do everything in his power to bring humanity to the next stage of evolution, even if it means trampling over the pathetic state of humanity as it exists today.

NEW QUESTS AND EVENTS

The Dark Phoenix Saga
Arriving to the unique multiversal Nexus of The Battlerealm, Dark Phoenix is fascinated by the existence of several other variants of herself. Dark, light, Jean, all here and all powerful. They see The Battlerealm as a perfect place to burn down and build anew with this abundance of power and possibility.

Event Quest - Grey Matter
Krakoa calls for aid as a mysterious ISO-infused infection is causing mutant mayhem! Nightcrawler and The Summoner try to help, but every step they take leads to more trouble. Jean Grey is thankfully able to put her mind on the task, but darkness is brewing in labs below the base. Will they be able to think of a way out? Find out in GREY MATTER!

Side Quest - Phoenix Force Five
The multiversal mayhem has shared Dark Phoenix’s power with other mighty Champions, and now it falls to the Summoner to redirect this fiery force! Be careful about what fights you pick, as each week the battles you choose will seal your fate!

Everest Quest - Grandmasters Gauntlet
Behold The Ordeal! This new Quest is a variation on the original Grandmaster’s Gauntlet, with the key difference being that all defenders will be 7-Star, Rank 4 and max Level versions of the Champions from the original Quest. Summoners will also be limited to bringing only 7-Star Champions into the Quest. Do you have what it takes to conquer this challenge?

Nightmare Raids
Alliances that crave a tougher challenge can test their teams against Nightmare Raids! This version of Raids operates the same as the existing map, but features different and much more punishing bosses. Plan ahead to give your Alliance the best chance of defeating the bosses and claiming lucrative rewards.

International Women’s Day
We have teamed up with 7 of our wonderful female Developers and Content Creator partners to let the Battlerealm decide on a Champion to be reworked this year. Each Developer or Content Creator will represent a different Champion, and Summoners will complete Solo Objectives and take part in Realm Events in order to determine which fearsome Champion will reign supreme!

Cyclops (Blue Team) Double Track Event
Take part in this new Double Track Eve

NEW CHAMPIONS

Arnim Zola
A brilliant Swiss scientist and the world’s foremost authority in biochemistry and genetic engineering, Zola strove to create an army of super-soldiers and helped with the founding of Hydra. When his own body failed, Zola discovered a way to digitize his consciousness, transferring his mind into a robotic body. In this immortal mechanical form, Zola has worked to ensure the dominance of both Hydra and his own genius throughout the decades.

Falcon (Joaquin Torres) - OUR 300th CHAMPION!
Joaquín Torres came to the United States with his family at a young age, always with the aspiration to do good by them, and by his heritage. While on a supply run to assist his local community, he was kidnapped by the Sons of the Serpent, and sent for experimentation. Eventually he was rescued by Sam Wilson, but it was too late and Joaquín was already made into a falcon/human hybrid. With this irreversible mutation, Joaquín accepted his powers and took the mantle of the new Falcon. He now fights alongside Sam as one of America’s newest Heroes.

NEW QUESTS AND EVENTS

Event Quest - Screen Time
Avenger’s tower has gone silent and Eli Bradly and Joaquin Torres (AKA Patriot and Falcon) will need to investigate. However they will be facing off against friends and foes alike as Arnim Zola breaks the calm with reveals of his villainous plots. Will the team be able to take in the whole picture? Or will they be blinded by the sinister science of Zola? Find out in SCREEN TIME!

Side Quest - ‘Til Deathless Do Us Part
Captain America and the new Falcon, are on a diplomatic mission to see if The Avengers can broker peace with the new Deathless faction that has sprung up in The Battlerealm. Surprisingly, the Deathless are amenable to an alliance, but some villains are also vying for the Deathless' support. The heroic duo will have to compete for the top spot as the Deathless' new BFF.

Everest Quest - Epoch of Pain
After testing you for 4 seasons, Ares has prepared your final exam. Do you have what it takes to conquer the latest permanent Everest quest, the Epoch of Pain?

Incursions Deathless Saga Sector
Take your Deathless Champions into the latest Incursions Saga Sector and fight for Deathless Signature Stones and a generic Rank-Up Gem!

True Bromance Battlegrounds Event
Take part in Pre-Season 26 of Battlegrounds to complete Solo Objectives and a special Solo Event that award Crystals, Profile Pics, Emotes and more!

OTHER NEW FEATURES

Instant Rank-Up Offers
For Conqueror+ players, Instant Rank-Up Offers are available for 1-5 Star Champions for all ranks. For Thronebreaker+ players, Instant Rank-Up Offers are now available for 6-Star Champions rank 1 to 2.

Daily Super Event 2.0
We are introducing a change to the visual presentation of the Daily Super Event. There is now a widget that lives permanently on the home screen, and will be accessible whenever the navigation bar is expanded on every other screen. This change is intended to make the event,

Spring Festival Event Series
As the clip-clop of hooves bids farewell to the passing year, the arrival of the new year brings fresh fortune and hope. Let's celebrate the coming of spring with our Spring Festival event series!
1. Rider's Tidings: Great fortune arrives with the Year of the Horse! Complete daily quests to earn abundant rewards, including Wishing Coins!
2. Auspicious Greetings: Log in daily to claim gifts, and unlock even greater premium rewards!
3. Lucky Red Packet: Begin the new year on a high by sharing a lucky gift!
4. Esmeralda's Prayer: We never know when the wheel of life will stop turning. Maybe your luck can change?
5. Sharp Eyes & Quick Hands: Earn rewards and compete with other governors throughout the kingdom in this fun jigsaw puzzle challenge!
6. Treasure Hunt: Collect Treasure Map Fragments and hunt for treasure!
7. Race Against Time: Who can eliminate the most barbarians in the shortest time?

Lost Kingdom and Season of Conquest Changes
1. New Honing Feature for Armaments:
- Governors can now steadily enhance the attributes of Legendary Armaments using the new honing feature.
- Only select armament attributes can be improved through honing, which include: the Attack, Defense, Health, and March Speed attributes of infantry, cavalry, archer, and siege units, as well as all damage.
- Attributes other than all damage increase by 0.2% each time you hone, with a maximum increase of 3.5%; if you choose to hone all damage, gain a 0.1% increase each time, with a maximum increase of 2.0%.
- Honing consumes Honing Stones, which can only be obtained from the Autarch-limited section of the Inscription Shop.
- Honing Stones will be available via the Inscription Shop in the Lost Kingdom after this version update.
2. Optimized Voting Rules During the Matchmaking Phase:
- When matchmaking results are announced, each kingdom may cast a vote. Votes are calculated independently for each camp. If more than 80% of the votes within a camp reject the result, that camp is considered to have refused the match; otherwise, the result is accepted.
- If all camps in the Lost Kingdom choose to reject the matchmaking result, this match will be canceled and all the kingdoms will re-enter story registration.
- These changes apply only to story registration after the version update.
3. Optimized By-Election Rules:
Kingdoms that have reached their skip limit for story registration will be assigned to a story with a higher likelihood of successful matchmaking during the by-election phase. Kings will not be able to refuse this assignment.

1. The Supreme Strife Tournament Is About to Begin!
1) Registration Rules: If your City Hall is level 25 and you are in the Season of Conquest, you can form or join a Pact at any time between the start of the event and the end of the registration period.
2) Qualifying for the Strife: At the end of the registration period, the top 64 Pacts by total power in your server region (International or China) will qualify for the Supreme Strife.
3) Format:
- The Supreme Strife consists of multiple rounds of matches, with 8 Pacts in each match. At the end of each match, the 4 Pacts with the most points will advance to the next round.
- The tournament lasts for a month, with a round of matches held every Saturday. Pact leaders can vote on the specific start time for their match. Each match lasts for 4 hours.
4) Forming Pacts:
- After the Supreme Strife event begins, you can create or join a temporary alliance called a "Pact". You do not need to leave your regular alliance to join a Pact, and Pact member limits will increase as the event progresses.
- You cannot quit your Pact if it is advancing to the next round. If your Pact gets eliminated, you can quit the Pact and join an advancing one.
5) Gameplay:
- In each match, Pacts will be ranked by their points. They can earn points by occupying Supreme Sites located across the battlefield.
- All governors will receive buffs equal to max-level Crystal techs and Past Glory bonuses. Lost Kingdom buffs will not take effect in the Supreme Strife battlefield.
- To claim territory, Pacts can build Pact Flags on the Supreme Strife battlefield. Pact Flags have a 350% bonus to construction speed and have a fixed Durability of 1000. The build speed of Pact Flags is not affected by the number of governors helping to build it.
- A certain proportion of severely wounded units in field and stronghold battles will instead be killed. Severely wounded units will be instantly healed at no cost when they return to their owner's city.
- At the end of each Supreme Strife match, the majority of units killed during the match will be resurrected for free.
- In the Supreme Strife, commanders can equip skills from auxiliary commanders at no cost, allowing for all-new strategic combinations.
6) Rewards:
- After the end of each Supreme Strife match, all participating governors will receive generous rewards. Governors who advance to the next round will receive bonus rewards.
- Governors will receive additional rewards based on their Pact's final ranking. The reward pool includes permanent city themes, exclusive titles, marching effects, teleport effects, avatar frames, name plaques, and other in-game item rewards.
- By killing enemy units and training units in the Supreme Strife, governors can level up their Supreme Pass battle pass and unlock new rewards. Purchase the Supreme Soldier bundle to access extra rewards and added benefits.

Hay Day Update 1.67
Hey, farmers! Our latest update is here, packed with new ways to boost your farm, earn rewards, and enjoy the season in style. Here’s what’s new:

- Fresh Beats (Beta):
We’re introducing a brand-new temporary perk that instantly boosts your crops, animals, or production for a short time. This early preview will be available for beta-testing to some players while we collect feedback and refine it. We’re looking forward to hearing the community's reaction to this feature before the full rollout.

- Tiny Trail:
We are testing a bite-sized Truck Order Event running for just 4 days, with Diamonds & Coins as the main rewards. Since this is an early test, not everyone will see the event right away. We’ll be working on ways to bring it to more farmers, in the future.

- Surprise Boxes:
 A more intentional way to get the Decorations. Every box you open increases your chances of getting the reward you're hoping for.

- Seasonal Creatures:
Limited-time visitors can appear on your farm, friends’ farms, or during special in-game events. Keep your eyes open, and you might see some guests appearing soon...

- Easier Tree & Bush Help Requests:
We are making it easier to request help for bushes and trees. Drag the help sign across multiple fruit trees and bushes to request help all at once.

- New Animals & Decorations, including Pet Birds:
Let's welcome to the farm;  Blueberry Muffin, Blueberry Cheesecake, Brown Capybara Pup, Red Capybara Pup, Horse Stable, Scarlet Macaw,  Hyacinth Macaw (Available in October).

- Derby Improvements: Multiple Derby bug fixes & improvements.

Hey there, Farmer! The first signs of spring are here, and one of them is an all-new Hay Day update! Check out these fun new features:

Event Board Redesign
- The event board is new and improved! It’s now easier to access events and save your favorites, so you don’t miss a beat.
- Live April 1st for all players!

Chocolate Egg Maker
- Produce delicious chocolate eggs in this new special production building – available for a limited time only!

Stickerbook Collection
- You can now collect more than one reward from a Stickerbook Collection! More treats await at each milestone before you finish a collection.

Postman Decorations
- Get a Wish Tree and a Combine Harvester to spruce up the homestead. Coming up in April!

And, as always, that’s not all! Tons of exciting events and sweet rewards are heading your way this spring!

Seasons greetings, Farmer! A chill is in the air, snow is falling, and that means that it's time for a winter update in Hay Day! We have plenty of delightful new content and features to look forward to.

New Crop
- Time to get cozy with Chamomile!
- This calming crop can be used to produce multiple new products for existing Production Buildings such as Chamomile Essential Oil from the Essential Oils Lab, a Soothing Pad from the Sewing Machine, and Chamomile Tea from the Tea Stand
- Put Chamomile to use in a new Production Building, the Perfumerie

New Production Building
- Welcome the Perfumerie to the Farm!
- The Perfumery uses items from your Farm including the new crop Chamomile to create 3 products: a Fresh Diffuser, Zesty Perfume, and a Calming Diffuser perfect for a busy holiday season

New Birds
- 3 lovely Swans land on the Farm over the next three months and can be unlocked with Chick Vouchers, with the first flying in this December

Holiday in Hay Day
- Get ready for a new Temporary Production Building! The Gift Wrapping Station produces four different Gifts
- Naughty or nice? A special Catalogue is here with plenty of adorable decorations, boosters, and more. Unlock whatever rewards your heart desires with this month's special currency: Holly
- Maggie has new customizations for your Farmhouse, Roadside Shop, and Truck
- Plus plenty of new decorations to bring holiday cheer to your Farm

And there's more on the way over the course of January and February with new events, decorations, and more! So bundle up, stay warm, and we will see you on the Farm!
Our ducks are now in a row! We made some tiny tweaks to keep your farm in tip-top shape.

Hey, Farmer! The seasons are changing, which means it's time for an update in Hay Day! We've spruced things up with plenty of new features and content releasing in October, and of course there's more to look forward to in November and December.

Halloween in Hay Day
- Get ready for a new temporary production machine that produces four candy treats. No tricks here!
- Halloween themed Farm Pass decorations, along with a spooky sweet animal accessory.
- New Halloween decorations as well as plenty of customizations to be unlocked in Maggie's shop

Scenic Mode
- Get ready for your closeup! With this new feature you can take stunning screenshots of your Farm, Town, and the Fishing area
- You’ll find the Scenic Mode button in the hamburger menu.
- Tap anywhere on the screen to exit Scenic Mode.

Improvements to Edit Mode User Experience
- This improvement aims to unify the deco shop and edit mode as much as possible.
- You asked, we listened! We've made requested changes to the functioning of Edit Mode, including the ability to erase by a swipe, and others!

Sanctuary Animals
- Baby Ostriches are here! Don't miss out on these two cuties.

And there’s more on the way over the course of November and December, with new quality of life updates, decorations, events and more! See you on the Farm!

com.iflow.lastbeacon.ios.n:
"Improvements & Adjustments
1. Reaching certain Lighthouse levels will now automatically send a red envelope to your Alliance members, letting you share the joy of your progress.
2. The Arms Race event will be phased out after running for a period of time and replaced with a more engaging, accessible themed points event.
3. After activating the Super Monthly Card, you can exchange any unused Super Monthly Card Discount Coupons for Ark Tokens.
4. Added two new gifts: Balloon and Peaceful Nap.
5. Updated the appearance of certain buildings and heroes.
6. Optimized the game for better compatibility with iPhone models.
7. Fixed display issues affecting certain languages.
8. Fixed an issue that caused chat channels to appear misaligned."

"Optimizations
1. VIP Points are now automatically applied and accumulated when earned. Any VIP Points in your inventory will be automatically redeemed upon your first login after this update.
2. Added a carousel feature for March Skins. You can now set multiple March Skins to rotate when your fleet sets sail.
3. Expanded Intel (Radar) Challenges, with additional monster levels added in The Lumen Era.
4. Optimized the avatar upload process. The interface has been updated to a pop-up window, now featuring confirmation prompts and violation warnings before submission.
5. Added a cooldown period for avatar uploads. After uploading an avatar, a 24-hour cooldown will be triggered, during which you cannot change your avatar again.
6. Implemented controls for inappropriate avatars. Banned accounts will be prohibited from uploading custom avatars, and any existing custom avatars will be cleared.
7. Added a quick friend request feature in Personal Profiles. When viewing another player's profile via their avatar, a new ""Add Friend"" button will appear at the bottom, allowing you to send a friend request instantly.
8. Custom naming for the Overlord is now supported. You can give your Overlord a unique name to create your one-of-a-kind oceanic behemoth.

Bug Fixes
1. Fixed an issue where tapping @ message notifications in the Friends List would not redirect you to the corresponding chat.
2. Fixed text garbling issues in the Alliance interface.
3. Fixed an issue where the system would automatically abandon a city immediately after it was occupied.
4. Fixed occasional noticeable lag experienced during gameplay in the Undersea Adventure."

"New Gameplay
1. Rust Battlefield: A new 10-player real-time battle mode. Earn points by capturing strongholds, gathering resources, and seizing airdrops. Heroes from both cross-seasons and the current season can participate.
2. Supreme Sea King: A new limited-time ranking event. Complete daily objectives to earn points and compete on the server-wide leaderboard.
3. Alliance Clash: A new alliance-based competitive mode. Multiple alliances compete for strongholds, earning points for your alliance through battles.
4. Glory Duel: A new stage-based challenge mode. Form your troops to advance through stages, earn war merits via eliminations and win streaks, and exchange them for exclusive rewards.

System & Experience Optimizations
1. Achievement System: Added personal and alliance achievements with more honor milestones to unlock.
2. Localization: Added Arabic language support for a better localized experience in more regions.
3. Appearance Update: Hero Tarik receives a visual upgrade with a brand-new look.
4. Social Experience: Alliance announcements now support images for more intuitive communication.
5. Progression Display: Combat power details in player profiles now include Drone and Overlord progression modules for clearer tracking.
6. Operation Optimization: Improved buff usage experience, allowing quick activation of all war-related buffs.
7. Art Optimization: Enhanced visual presentation for Mine Battles, making the distinction between large and small mines clearer."
Optimized server performance to enhance game stability.
Optimized server performance to enhance game stability.

**New Features**

**New Mode: Glory Duel**
Assemble your armies, conquer three stages, and rise to the summit — the Glory Duel has begun! Earn Battle Merit through elimination rounds and win streaks, and exchange them for exclusive limited rewards! Compete across the server — the battle awaits!

**New Mode: Block Challenge**
A classic block-matching mini-game — help the otters collect food and enjoy endless fun clearing levels! The exclusive leaderboard is now live with generous rewards up for grabs. Match, clear, and double the joy!

**Optimizations & Adjustments**

1. The total recovery cap for Battlefield Aid has been increased from 90% to 100%, with an initial recoverable amount of 40%. The number of times each player can assist has been raised from 20 to 50.
2. The wave limit for Wanderer Hunt has been adjusted to 30 waves, making the challenge节奏 more intense!
3. The Auto-Rally function has been optimized: "All Troops Join" has been renamed to "Auto-Select Join." When enabled, the auto-rally troop limit will be based on remaining troop capacity / remaining fleet capacity.
4. For Supreme Ark Wonder management, only the President can manage Wonders in the sea area. The Wonder appearances owned by each alliance have been adjusted, and the unique Wonder coordinates have been relocated to the Ark zone.
5. The Shelter visuals have been refreshed! The overall color scheme and style have been unified, the lighthouse model has been upgraded, resident animations are now more natural and fluid, and the Overlord effects have been fully optimized.
6. Cross-server relocation return has been optimized. After cross-server relocation, the system will automatically record the pre-relocation coordinates. Upon returning, players will be teleported to the original coordinates and enter placement mode.

New Content
New Event: Mine Battles
Attack mines, hold your ground, and gather valuable resources! A brand-new battlefield is now open. Earn Merits by taking control and fighting, then exchange them for generous rewards! Mine Battles awaits!

Improvements & Adjustments
1. Added a new exclusive Shelter skin for the Supreme Ark President: Ark Core.
2. Updated the appearance of the Overlord Base in the Shelter.
3. Adjusted the unlock levels for several buildings. Check the in-game details for more information.
4. Improved the Wonder battle experience with new battle records and messaging features.
5. Added Red-quality Parts for Drones.
6. Added Orange-quality decorations to Glowtide Garden, obtainable through Alliance Duel.
7. Added a new Garrison feature. Fleets can now be dispatched to unoccupied areas to claim territory and establish Garrison Camps.
8. Updated the appearance of Wonders for a more consistent visual style. Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque has been replaced with Pyramid, and the Great Wall has been replaced with Moai.

1. Launched Lumen Era new chapter with Lumen Core resource system for buildings & troops

2. Added 3 limited events: Whale Hunt, Seaside Carnival, Lumen Awakening to gain core materials & rare rewards

3. New Skin Shop released, providing avatar frames, lighthouse skins, garden ornaments and more custom items

4. Added time-limited mini-game "Find Godzzy" with ranking rewards

5. Reworked Wonder skill unlock logic (progressive unlock during construction, boosted skill effects on upgrades)

6. Added legendary Glowtide Garden decorations obtainable from alliance battles and world bosses

1.New "Salvage Vessel" Gameplay: We have introduced a brand-new "Salvage Vessel" system, offering players a more strategic way to explore and acquire resources, further enriching the core survival experience.

2.Adjusted Event Timings: To ensure a fairer and better experience for players across all time zones, we have adjusted the open times for the "Oasis War" and "Wanderer Hunt" events.

3.Tides of Trade Event Optimization: We have comprehensively optimized the interaction logic and functionality of the "Tides of Trade" event to make operations much more convenient and fluid.

4.Drone Visual Upgrade: The 3D models in the drone progression system have received an art overhaul, enhancing overall visual quality and detail.

5.Server Performance Improvements: Underlying server performance has been significantly boosted, effectively reducing latency and lag to ensure a more stable and reliable gaming experience.

1.Onboarding Art Upgrade: We have comprehensively optimized the early-stage onboarding art, including redesigned buildings and props, to provide a better visual experience for new players.

2.Server & Cross-Server Performance: Server performance has been significantly improved. Cross-server gameplay has been optimized to ensure a smoother experience for our global player base.

3.In-Game Gifting System: A new gifting feature has been added to enhance social interaction and fun among players.

4.System & UI Optimization: Various system functions and interactive elements have been streamlined to make daily operations more convenient.
